articleTitle: Research on Speed Measurement in MTI Radars
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In radar system, the speed information of target is very useful. This paper introduces three types of speed measurement algorithms used in MTI radars, which are unwrapping phase difference ambiguity algorithm, coherent integration algorithm and Chinese Remainder Theorem. Simulation analysis and comparison are given for each algorithm. The calculation results of radar measured data show that the MTI speed measurement algorithms can effectively distinguish between high-speed targets and low-speed targets.

articleTitle: Research on Vertical Parking Path Planning of Semi-trailer Train Based on Improved Hybrid A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of parking semi-trailer trains, the vertical parking path planning of semi-trailer trains was studied based on the improved hybrid A* algorithm. Firstly, the vehicle kinematics model is established. Then, the original algorithm is improved on the basis of the hybrid A* algorithm, so that it can be applied to semi-trailer trains. Finally, the improved hybrid A* algorithm is verified by MATLAB simulation. The simulation results show that the improved hybrid A* algorithm can be used in general situations or when the vehicle has a certain initial heading angle. It can make the vehicle stop to the target parking space accurately and without error.

articleTitle: A fast jamming waveform design method based on distributed precision jamming
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Distributed precision jamming is a new electronic countermeasure technology, which uses several small signal transmitting carriers to jam the specific targets precisely by energy focusing. One of the typical applications is precision electronic warfare (PREW)., where the waveform design is also the point to guarantee the jamming effect. In this paper, a rapid coordinate descent (CD) algorithm is used to generate the constant modulus jamming waveform efficiently in the standard PREW scenario, and it directly optimizes the objective function by sequential iteration, so that the optimization objective approximates the ideal value continuously. Then, the jamming effect of the waveform generated by the algorithm is analyzed by numerical calculation and comparison. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can provide reasonable constant modulus jamming waveforms suitable for distributed accurate jamming in a short time.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Optical Flow Estimation for Video Infrared Small Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The spatio-temporal information among video sequences is significant for video infrared (IR) small target detection. To effectively utilize the supplementary temporal information, existing video IR small target detection methods usually use optical flow to perform motion estimation and compensation. The common optical flow-based detection methods can only capture small motion of video sequences. However, the slow IR imaging speed and wide viewing distance resulting the spatial location of the target between two frames is frequently different, which limits the efficacy of optical flow-based detection methods. To solve the problem, we propose an end-to-end video infrared small target detection method, which is more robust to large motion and can achieve more accurate motion compensation. Specifically, we first propose a multi-scale optical flow reconstruction network to perform motion estimation in a coarse-to-fine manner. Then, the generated optical flows are used to align the neighborhood frames to the reference frame. Finally, the aligned neighborhood frames are concatenated and fed to the detection network to generate detection results. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed reconstruction network provides more accurate motion estimation and can achieve improved performance on both detection accuracy and temporal consistency. Comparative results on the infrared video datasets show that our framework achieves the state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Fusing CNNs and Transformers for Deformable Medical Image Registration
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Deformable medical image registration is fundamental for many medical image studies. In the field of deformable image registration, convolutional neural network (CNN) based methods cannot effectively deal with large deformation settings due to the local receptive fields. Transformers are good at modeling long-range dependency, but the lack of convolutional induction bias can lead to limited ability of grasping local details. In this paper, we propose a novel parallel architecture combining CNNs and Transformers, FTNet, to tackle this issue. FTNet contains convolutional branch and Transformer branch that extract features independently, with the proposed fusion strategy, the encoded features from both branches are efficiently fused. Extensive experiments on two brain image datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior registration accuracy against other state-of-the-art methods while maintaining desired diffeomorphic properties of deformation fields.

articleTitle: NAM Net: Meta-Network with Normalization-based Attention for Few-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Few-shot learning aims to learn a classifier to recognize unseen classes with limited labeled examples. The scarcity of training data remains a challenging problem in few-shot classification. Many few-shot learning methods focus on the structure of meta-network models and there is often no dedicated study of meta-knowledge representation. In this paper, a meta-learning strategy is introduced and a meta-network NAM Net is proposed. Taking the advantage of ‘learning to learn’, the model acquires meta-knowledge via few-shot classification tasks and applies it to new few-shot scenarios. Specifically, the meta-learner learns the best parameters of the feature extraction and similarity metric modules. The distance between the support feature and query feature is obtained by a learnable metric function, which leads to the classification result. The base learner migrates the meta-knowledge to the target class to perform classification in a new few-shot episode. Moreover, the Normalization-based Attention Module is adapted to feature extractor to enhance meta-knowledge representation. Compared with few-shot learning benchmarks, NAM Net is effective and achieves higher accuracy in both 5-way 1-shot and 5-shot classification tasks.

articleTitle: An Application of the IoVs Information Sharing Scheme Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Data generated in the internet of vehicles (IoVs) system is always considered to improve the driving performance of vehicle manufacturers. Aiming at the issues of security privacy and low willingness of users involved in the data sharing of IoVs, the paper proposes an IoVs information sharing scheme with double-chains parallelizing, combining asymmetric encryption technology and smart contract in blockchain. There are two chains in this novel scheme, one is data to be uploaded chain includes vehicles' data and the other is uploading data chain includes the requests of users. The scheme is secure and voluntary circulation by the automatic execution of smart contracts and this scheme can motivate vehicle users to become information production nodes and share high-quality and highly reliable IoVs information for other users in the region.

articleTitle: Coherent DOA Estimation Using Dynamic Metasurface Antenna Working in Space Isomeric Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Spatial smoothing is a common solution that can be used to improve the performance of coherent signals at the cost of increased array size requirement. In this paper, we propose a modified spatial smoothing method to estimate direction-of-arrival (DOA) of coherent signals based on dynamic metasurface antenna (DMA), which improve estimation accuracy under the condition of array aperture limitation. Specifically, a DMA working in space isomeric mode is constructed by employing array elements with uncorrelated observation functions. Moreover, with spatial smoothing, the rank of each covariance matrix observed by DMA is restored for resolving coherent signals. Simulation results show that the proposed method has higher resolution performance and estimation accuracy than existing methods based on uniform linear array (ULA) at the same elements. Theoretical performance analysis and numerical examples validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Trajectory Prediction of Surrounding Vehicles for Autonomous Vehicle Using POMDP Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The uncertain behavior of surrounding vehicles in lane changing scenario is one of the most potential risk for the autonomous vehicle. Trajectory prediction plays a critical role in the condition of safe obstacle avoidance. Considering the partial observable state of the surrounding vehicles, trajectory prediction model of surrounding vehicles for autonomous vehicle based on POMDP (Partially Observable Markova Decision Process) principle have been proposed in this paper. The driver's intention recognition and the vehicle trajectory have been applied to train the prediction model parameters. The experiment has been implemented with NGSIM traffic data set. Experimental results show that the trajectory prediction model we proposed can predict the trajectory accurately. Results of preview time ahead have dramatic advancement with performance surpassing classic method.

articleTitle: Application of an improved immune particle swarm optimization algorithm in reactive power optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: For the reactive power optimization problem of power system, particle swarm optimization algorithm is an effective probability search algorithm for global optimization. However, although the basic particle swarm optimization algorithm has fast convergence speed, it is easy to converge prematurely and fall into the local optimal solution. In this paper, an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is applied to reactive power optimization. The algorithm adjusts the inertia weight and learning factor of particle swarm optimization algorithm. At the same time, the immune algorithm is integrated with particle swarm optimization algorithm. In application, the algorithm can make up for the defects of the basic particle swarm optimization algorithm, search and determine the optimal solution in the global range, effectively avoid premature convergence, and the convergence speed is greatly improved. Simulation results show that the algorithm applied to reactive power optimization can accurately find the global optimal solution, significantly accelerate the convergence speed, effectively reduce system loss and improve power quality.

articleTitle: Deep Factorized Q-Learning for Large Scale Multi-Agent Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The value function decomposition is an effective way to alleviate the curse of dimension in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). However, the existing methods usually either can only provide the low-order approximate decomposition of no more than the second-order, or need to spend a lot of effort to manually design the high-order interaction among agents according to experience. Therefore, the existing methods either tend to bear large decomposition error or are not convenient to use. In this paper, a high-order approximate value function decomposition method is proposed, which can be trained end-to-end. There have some prominent features about this method including low-rank vector exploited to represent value function, both low- and high-order component sharing the same input (i.e., the embedding vector), the model parameters shared among all the agents if they are homogeneous. Experimental results show that our method is effective.

articleTitle: Improved Aquila Optimizer Optimization Algorithm Based on Multi-strategy Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of slow convergence speed and relatively weak local development ability of Aquila Optimizer optimization algorithm, a Tianying optimization algorithm based on adaptive cross mutation is proposed. Firstly, the inertia weight factor is introduced into the location update formula in the global development stage to adjust the influence degree of the optimal individual on the population. Secondly, the vertical and horizontal crossing strategy is introduced into the local development of the algorithm to exchange individual information across dimensions and improve the local development ability; Finally, Cauchy elite mutation is introduced to avoid the algorithm falling into local optimization. The function optimization simulation experiments of five representative comparison algorithms on 23 different feature benchmark functions show that the optimization accuracy and stability of the proposed improved algorithm are significantly improved. Keywords: Aquila Optimizer optimization algorithm; Inertia weight factor; Vertical and horizontal cross strategy; Cauchy elite variation

articleTitle: SAR image registration based on KECA-SAR-SIFT operator
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image registration is a key technology in SAR image processing. The accuracy and efficiency of registration directly affect the quality of subsequent image processing. In order to further improve the accuracy and computational efficiency of the traditional SAR-SIFT (SAR-scale invariant feature transform, SAR-SIFT) image registration algorithm, an improved SAR-SIFT algorithm based on Kernel entropy component analysis (KECA) is proposed. Firstly, the SAR-Harris scale space is established, the extreme points in the space are selected and the main directions of the key points are calculated; then, the SAR-SIFT descriptor is generated, and the KECA algorithm is used for further feature extraction, and the KECA-SAR-SIFT descriptors is obtained after dimensionality reduction; finally, feature points of two or more pictures are matched by comparing the similarity of the extracted descriptors. The experimental results showed that the proposed method effectively improved the matching accuracy, shortened the matching time, and had certain robustness.

articleTitle: Research on multi-directional automatic parking of Ackerman car model such as vertical parking, parallel parking and oblique parking
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, the automatic parking has become the hot issue of concern. Determining the optimal parking location and path based on the CRITIC weight method is the key issue to solve the problem of automatic parking. Several related factors should be considered such as the steering wheel speed and degree of motor. In this paper, we design the optimal parking location and path for the automatic parking. Firstly, the Ackerman physical model of the vehicle is constructed with some constrained basic parameters and function relations. Later, the automatic parking physical model is constructed. Then the path planning and design modeling is carried out by taking vertical parking, parallel parking and oblique parking as research objects. By constructing the “two-arc” model and “multi-arc” model, the three cases are modeled respectively. The parking trajectory is calculated and processed by sections, and the visual trajectory and parameter level are obtained by using Python and MATLAB programming for motion tracking calculation. In conclusion, the optimal path planning and parameter changes of three main parking space models in the process of automatic parking are studied and obtained through modeling analysis.

articleTitle: An impulsive noise mitigation and channel estimation algorithm based on unitary approximate message passing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Impulsive noise and fading channels can severely damage communication system performance. In this paper, we propose an impulsive noise mitigation and channel estimation algorithm based on unitary approximate message passing-sparse Bayesian learning. The algorithm integrates variational inference and unitary transformation to enhance convergence and robustness, allowing for more accurate impulsive noise and channel estimation The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm owns superior performance than gaussian generalized approximate message passing-sparse Bayesian learning algorithm in terms of mean square error, normalized mean square error, and computational complexity of impulsive noise and channel estimation as well as bit error rate.

articleTitle: Multi-core DSP-based Acceleration of SAR BP Algorithm Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The back projection (BP) imaging algorithm is a time-domain synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imaging algorithm. The BP algorithm does not perform approximation processing during imaging and has high imaging accuracy. However, the BP algorithm needs sub-image imaging at each azimuth moment, which has a high computational complexity and limits the application in scenarios with high imaging rate requirements. Therefore, in this paper we proposed a parallel acceleration scheme of the BP algorithm based on the FT-M3000 digital signal processor (DSP) to parallelize the computation of sub-images at each azimuth moment in sub-aperture imaging, and realize parallel imaging of four sub-aperture data. Experimental results show that the total imaging time of the four sub-aperture images is 4.12 seconds, compared with the imaging time of the four sub-aperture images using a 3.3GHz CPU for 263.65 seconds, and the imaging speed of this scheme is increased by 64 times.

articleTitle: Statistical CSI based Design for Intelligent Reflecting Surface-Assisted mmWave MU-MISO Communications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This work studies a joint active and passive precoding design at the base station and intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) to maximize the ergodic spectral efficiency in a multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) millimeter wave system by utilizing the statistical timescale channel state information (CSI). Specifically, both the active and passive precoder are optimized utilizing the statistical CSI of all channels. Nevertheless, such an optimization problem is tricky to solve due to the non-convexity. Using the fractional programming, our work proposes an efficient algorithms to design jointly the active and passive precoders. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms and the benefits of the IRS.

articleTitle: Research on Image Recognition and Grading Method of Apple Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to achieve intelligent, fast and accurate grading of apples, Apple's image acquisition and recognition system has been built, which is based on machine vision technology. Through color-to-gray, image noise reduction, image enhancement, and image segmentation processing of the collected image, three characteristics of the shape, size and color of the apple were recognized. Taking the 3 features of the apple identified from the image recognized as input, a multi-feature fusion classification method based on image processing and SVM was proposed in this paper. Through the constructed SVM vector machine, the apple's shape, size and color are synthesized to judge the apple's grade. The experimental results show that the classification method has the characteristics of high recognition rate and good real-time performance. This method lays the foundation for the application of machine vision technology in apple grading.

articleTitle: Robustness Analysis and Modeling of UAV Cluster System Based on Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: For the robustness problem of UAV cluster after being attacked and reconstructed, Firstly, the hive UAV network model is established by complex network method, Then random attacks and targeted attacks are carried out on the model, The method of link reconstruction using the motif degree centrality and other indexes is proposed. Thus, the attack-reconstruction model is constructed. In order to evaluate the effectiveness of the model, a comprehensive evaluation method considering the robustness of complex network indicators and UAV cluster mission performance is proposed. Then, the robustness of UAV cluster network under two attack modes is analyzed. Finally, the simulation results show that this method can quickly judge whether UAV cluster network has robustness.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Air Source Heat pumps Heating System Based on Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to accelerate the use of renewable energy for rural residential heating in northern China, reduce fossil energy consumption of heating system, and reduce pollution caused by energy burning as well, Based on the real-time monitoring of heating units, the parameters such as average efficiency, heating system efficiency, solar guarantee rate and water supply temperature of solar collector system under different outdoor temperatures are taken into account, optimize the energy efficiency of the entire heating system by water supply temperatures on analyzing the system COP.The results showed that with the increase of water supply temperature, the COP value of the system also tends to increase, and the system COP reached the maximum value at 40°C. It is feasible to use solar-air heat pumps for heating in Shenyang area, which provides theoretical basis and data reference for the popularization of the system.

articleTitle: Improved hyperspectral target tracking algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of material-based background sensing correlation filter in target deformation, the original algorithm MHT is improved. Firstly, the abnormal judgment of the response diagram is added to the original MHT algorithm. If there is no abnormal response diagram of the tracking target, the original MHT algorithm is used for target tracking. If the response graph of the tracking target is abnormal, the abnormal response graph is suppressed by the anomaly suppression algorithm, and then the suppressed response graph is input back to the MHT algorithm. Finally, the Whisper hyperspectral video dataset is used to track the algorithm. The test results show that the improved algorithm improves the tracking success rate and tracking accuracy compared with the original algorithm MHT.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Method for Detecting Phone Call Behaviors of Bidding Evaluation Expert
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of information technology, bidding evaluation process has changed from the traditional offline paper-based mode to online digital mode. To ensure an open and fair environment for online bidding evaluation, an intelligent supervision system is needed, which includes the phone call behavior detection. In this paper, we proposed a deep learning method for bidding evaluation expert's phone call behaviors detection. The proposed method consists of object detection and ROI analysis. In the detection stage, the phone and head are detected with our proposed YOLOv5+Transformer network. The phone call behavior is then recognized with self-defined ROI analysis. The experimental results show that the mAP is increased by 4.8% with the proposed network when compared with original YOLOv5s. In addition, the proposed method is used to analyze the video stream comprehensively, which can effectively solve the problems of object scale variation, occlusion, and accurately detect the phone call behavior.

articleTitle: A Survey of Deep learning-based Image caption
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Image caption is to use computer vision technology to extract the semantic content information contained in the image, and use natural language processing technology to generate a reasonable text caption. This paper takes the development of image description technology based on deep learning as the main line, and introduces the typical image description methods in each period. Image description generally adopts an encoding-decoding structure, which is the most commonly used method at present. By improving the encoder or decoder, increasing the attention mechanism, introducing Transformer technology, the advantages and disadvantages of different methods are discussed and summarized. Data sets and evaluation indicators such as MS-COCO and Flicker commonly used in this field are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: GNN-based Method for Predicting Access Control Relationships for Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Access control is one of the important technical means to achieve secure and controllable big data, but the lack of relational data inevitably affects the completeness of relational-based access control rules. Although existing link prediction techniques can be used for the prediction of entity relationships, they still face problems such as incomplete information elements and undifferentiated entity weights. To address these problems, this paper proposes a GNN-based link prediction model LPMG. The model proposes a node embedding feature learning method based on directed neighbor subgraphs, incorporates elements such as attention coefficients and relationship types, improves the representation capability of node embedding, and achieves link prediction of entity relationship graphs. The experiment results show that the model effectively improves the effect of link prediction and can meet the demand of big data access control relationship prediction.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in the Interactive Design of Art Museum Exhibition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A B/S based 3-dimensional museum art exhibition gallery model were created by the professional engine, Unity Pro, which provide a realistic interactive display and automatically parameter matching query of virtual theatre system on the web. By building a platform that transcend the limits of time and space, makes the information exchange in 3D Art exhibition hall of museum more convenient.

articleTitle: Research on railway emergency rescue time prediction based on IFBN-GERTS network model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Due to the great uncertainty of railway emergencies, it is difficult for the management departments to manage and control the rescue process and time. Therefore, this paper establishes an emergency rescue graphical evaluation review technique stochastic (GERTS) network to predict the rescue time based on the logical relationship between the rescue processes. Considering the uncertainty of on-site information at the early stage of an emergency, Bayesian networks (BN) are combined with intuitionistic fuzzy set (IFS) to construct intuitionistic fuzzy Bayesian networks (IFBN) for emergency rescue decision inference. The direct fuzzy numbers of the probabilities of the IFBN output nodes are introduced into GERTS as branching probabilities of the network nodes, increasing its ability to express uncertainty. Finally, the network logic is modeled in MATLAB and Monte Carlo ideas are adopted for the selection of branching activities according to the branching probabilities, and the network simulation results are statistically analyzed to obtain the expected time for the whole rescue process. By predicting the emergency rescue time, it can provide a basis for the adjustment of the travel plan and assist emergency managers in making scientific decisions.

articleTitle: A New CNN-based Joint Network for Brain Tumor Denoising and Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The Deep Learning (DL) method, especially the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based method have been applied in various fields of medical image processing and proven to be powerful for image classification, denoising task. However, there are not any end-to-end DL models for both denoising and classification tasks in existing methods, which would render a large number of parameters for models to deal with these tasks. In this work, we proposed an efficient auto-encoder model based on CNN for classification and denoising tasks for brain medical images (i.e. Magnetic Resonance Imaging), in addition, we proposed a connection between encoding and decoding units in our auto-encoder model and evaluated the contribution of it to denoising task. Our method achieved 99.7% in accuracy of classification the brain medical images on the Brain Tumor dataset from Kaggle, which has 3,762 brain medical images, in addition, the denoising performance of it was impressive, as the lowest average Mean Square Error (MSE) of the dataset was 0.00503 while the model achieved best classification performance.

articleTitle: Comparison of Convolutional Neural Network and Capsule Network in Image Recognition- A Case Study of Microbiopsy Images of Breast Tumor
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Cancer is now the leading causes of death. During treatment, if an abnormal mass is detected by routine mammography after histological examination, a biopsy will be performed for further diagnosis. However, the time required to review and evaluate the biopsy slide is very long. An effective algorithm that can identify cancer tissues and reduce the rate of misdiagnosis is urgently needed. The current research methods mainly include: Capsule Network, and Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) used in image classification, etc. This paper mainly uses Capsule Network, CNN, CNN trained on Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) images, and Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) to classify benign and malignant images of the tumor micro-biopsy images. The first step is to download the breast tumor micro-biopsy images from Breakhis. The second step is to preprocess the images, mainly image enhancement, augmentation, and HOG feature extraction. In the third step, the processed image data is used to train CNN and Capsule Network. The last step is to visualize the accuracy of model training and use confusion matrix to calculate the accuracy of image classification, recall rate, and so on. The results show that the accuracy of CNN with the help of transfer learning can reach 98.32%, the accuracy of CNN trained with HOG image is only 82.99%, the accuracy of CNN trained with GLCM is 92.79%, and the accuracy of capsule network can reach 92.39%.

articleTitle: Design of a metamaterial Luneburg lens antenna based on 3D printing technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Luneburg lens antenna has good directional and beam scanning properties which make it widely used in the field of radar antennas. In order to reduce the manufacture difficulty of the layered Luneburg lens, a Luneburg lens antenna based on periodic metamaterial units is proposed in this paper. the air-to-medium volume ratio of the unit structure in different positions is changed to meet the dielectric constant distribution requirement. Using 3D printing technology, a 50 mm radius Luneburg lens antenna is manufactured and tested. The results show that the gain of the Luneburg lens antenna at 10GHz is 14.98 dB, which is increased by 7.41 dB compared with a single waveguide feed. The antenna has good dynamic scanning characteristic, since the gain changes slightly with the scanning angle. The validity and feasibility of the analysis and design of the metamaterial Luneburg lens antenna are proved.

articleTitle: A Survey of Image Style Transfer Research
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Image conversion is the process of combining content images and style images to build a new picture. To facilitate the research on image style transfer, the most important methods and results of image style transfer are summarized and discussed. First, the concept of image style transfer is reviewed, and introduced in detail the image style migration method based on deep learning. Secondly, the basic content and algorithms of image mode transformation based on Gan cycle and Transformer are introduced. Finally, the current problems and future research directions of image style transfer based on deep learning are summarized.

articleTitle: A method for predicting the power generation of residential solar panels that is easy to popularize in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area‐‐‐‐‐based on GA optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Accurate prediction of distributed solar power generation is a key factor for the cost-effective operation of district heating and cooling networks. Traditional forecasts require multiple variables such as weather data and complex mathematical models, which are not suitable for promotion in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area where the weather is changeable. This paper proposes that this kind of problem adopts a simple SVR model, and at the same time, in order to improve the accuracy of the model, the GA algorithm is used to optimize. The power generation prediction method of residential solar panels in this paper is verified by public datasets. The innovations of this paper are: 1) The GA algorithm is still used to improve the prediction accuracy on the basis of the SVR model; 2) The K-fold cross-validation method is used in the improvement of the GA algorithm, which greatly accelerates the calculation of the prediction results.

articleTitle: Research on a Segmentation and Location Algorithm Based on Mask RCNN for Agaricus Bisporus
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper proposes a recognition and localization algorithm based on Mask RCNN(Mask Region-based Convolutional Neural Network) for Agaricus bisporus to address the problems caused by the poor environmental adaptability of traditional vision methods, such as high mushroom unrecognized rate especially for small mushrooms and sticky mushrooms, poor robustness of recognization, low accuracy of centroid localization, etc. Firstly, the algorithm uses Mask RCNN to segment Agaricus bisporuses and obtain the masks of each Agaricus bisporuses. Next, the Agaricus bisporus mask edges are extracted, then the ellipse is used to reconstruct the contour depending on the data of the mask edges, and the center point of the ellipse is taken as the center point of the Agaricus bisporus. The experiments show that the proposed algorithm in this paper has stronger robustness, it greatly improves the success rate of recognition of Agaricus bisporus under different light intensities and complex growth environments, and the generated contours much more fit with the actual contours, the size of the recognized Agaricus bisporus and the localization accuracy are higher, with the segmentation accuracy AP50 reaching 95.061%, which can better meet the requirements of Agaricus bisporus picking and its growth status monitoring.

articleTitle: An Efficient Offline Signature Verification Method Based on Improved Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As a kind of biometric system, handwritten signature verification has always been a research hotspot. Offline signature verification (OSV), although heavily researched in the past, remains shortcomings such as incomplete feature extraction, too many training samples and inconvenient promotion in practical applications, especially in distinguishing genuine signatures from skilled forgeries, which may be very close in appearance to the genuine ones. To solve these problems, in this paper, we propose a writer-dependent (WD) offline signature verification system, which extracts features from signature images through Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and Improved Local Binary Pattern (ILBP) respectively, and these features are fused with geometric features, and finally we use Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification. The MCYT75 and CEDAR public datasets are used to validate the proposed system, and the experimental results show advantages in both accuracy and average error rate (AER) compared with other existing methods. The accuracy rate (AR) reaches 97.58% and 97.0%, respectively, and 5.64% AER and 3.49% AER, respectively. The experimental results compare favorably with many of the state-of-the-art in handwritten signature verification, proving the usefulness of our designed system.

articleTitle: Transfer learning based on self-attention mechanism in sound event detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: SED is a task to detect sound segments. Recent research has found that models based on self-attention mechanism can have an edge on sound feature detection. However, the self-attention mechanism requests a large-scale data set which is difficult to achieve in the audio field. So, this paper proposes a transfer learning-based SED solution. Through the transfer of AST based on the self-attention mechanism, our model reduces the demand for the data. At the same time, we propose a new audio embedding processing method and significantly shorten the training time. After training using the DESED data set on the DCASE task, it completely ahead of CRNN. It reaches the Intersection-based F1 score of 91.4%, and 42.1% higher than CRNN, which reflects the superiority of the self-attention mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Value Identification of Video-on-demand services Based on RFM Improved Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: On video-on-demand service platforms, different customers are diverse and different in consumption intention, on-demand requirements, consumption duration, viewing habits and styles, and have different values to the platforms. Aiming at the customer value evaluation demand of video-on-demand platforms, combining the characteristics of video service platform and video website customers, we propose to incorporate customer loyalty into customer value evaluation and construct a customer value evaluation model RFMD (Recency, Frequency, Monetary, Duration) based on the improved RFM model for video-on-demand service platforms. Combined with the experimental data provided by BilliBilli, K-Means algorithm was used to complete the customer clustering analysis. The comparison results show that the proposed model is applicable to the customer value evaluation of video-on-demand service platforms, and it has a better customer value judgment effect, which can be used for high-quality customers recognition and customer segmentation.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Weighted Localization System based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Fingerprint-based indoor positioning system in dynamic environment needs to frequently correct fingerprint database and adjust parameters of positioning model. To alleviate this problem, this paper proposed an adaptive fingerprint positioning system based on fuzzy theory and transfer learning to reduce the cost of fingerprint collection and improve the positioning accuracy. Specifically, the transfer learning algorithm maps source fingerprint features and target fingerprint features into same space using target unlabeled fingerprints and source labeled fingerprints. After that, the fuzzy membership degree is calculated and assigned to different fingerprint positioning models, and then the joint fuzzy weighted model is used to predict the positioning results. The experiment test shows that the proposed system can improve localization accuracy and reduce cost of system.

articleTitle: A method for estimating an unknown target grasping pose based on keypoint detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of estimating the unknown target grasping pose in robotic applications, a pose estimation method based on crucial point detection is proposed, and the CenterNet-SPF (Subpixel- Feature Pyramid Networks) unknown object grasping pose estimation network is designed. CenterNet-SPF divides the grasping angle into 18 feature point types, sorts, and filters the weights of the feature points to obtain the key point category and corresponding point coordinates and then regresses the key points to get the grasping frame parameters, completing the target detection network to the grasping detection network. Improve the generalization ability of unknown target detection; design a feature extraction network structure for dual-channel feature fusion, introduce sub-pixel convolution instead of transposed convolution to perform dual-channel feature fusion for high and low-level features and increase the sampling convolutional layers, increases the feature output resolution to improve prediction accuracy. The CenterNet-SPF grasping pose estimation network was verified on the Cornell grasping dataset, and the prediction accuracy reached 98.31%; the generalization ability was tested on the untrained Jacquard dataset, and the recognition accuracy reached 95.5%; the actual application tests the success rate of middle grasping is 88.7%. The experimental results show that the proposed network can accurately detect the grasping pose of unknown targets, has good generalization ability, and can meet the application requirements of grasping tasks.

articleTitle: A Survey of Image Caption Tasks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Image caption technology is a new task in the field of computer vision after relay image recognition, image segmentation and object detection. This technology can input the image of the computer, through the mathematical model and the powerful calculation of the computer, and finally output the descriptive text that is highly related to the content of the image. In order to have a clear understanding of the current research status of image caption tasks and look forward to the future, this paper reviews the research progress of image caption tasks. In order to have a clear understanding of the current research status of image caption tasks and look forward to the future, this paper reviews the research progress of image caption tasks. This paper summarizes related methods, applicable datasets, and evaluation metrics for image caption tasks.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of High Performance SRAM Based on 110nm Process
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper introduces the single port <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2432\times 16$</tex> bit for microprocessor based on 110nm logic low-power process. Full custom design of high-speed low-power SRAM. In the design process, in order to obtain high speed and control power consumption, the circuit and layout of 6T memory cell are newly designed. Aiming at the large capacity of this design, the memory array is partitioned and the SRAM efficiency is improved by using hierarchical decoding. After the circuit design, the whole layout of SRAM is fully customized, and the function, speed and power consumption are simulated. The working frequency of this design is 132-473MHz, the voltage range is 1.25v∼1.65v, and the area is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$44925\text{um}^{\ \wedge}\ 2$</tex>. The average power consumption under 1.5V power supply voltage can reach 5.83mW, which is better than the previous design on the whole.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis and Prediction of Tunnel Excavation Based on ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to analyze and predict the influence of dynamic construction of TBM tunnel on surrounding environment, the dynamic calculation model was established by using ABAQUS finite element software, and the TBM tunnel dynamic excavation simulation was carried out. Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) with Matlab was used to obtain the frequency domain curve (Fourier spectrum) of vibration acceleration, and the variation law of ground vibration at different distances from the working surface was analyzed. At the same time, the peak value of ground vertical acceleration was effectively predicted by BP neural network. The results show that: 1) With the increase of distance, the lateral and vertical accelerations of the ground surface decrease sharply, and the longitudinal acceleration increases first and then decreases rapidly. 2) The spectral components of surface vibration wave are complex, showing obvious low frequency characteristics. 3) It is feasible to use BP neural network algorithm to predict the peak value of ground vertical acceleration caused by TBM tunnel excavation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of USB 5 VCPs Concurrent Communications on SCU AC Acquisition and Metering Unit Based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to implement 5-channel concurrent communications based on USB virtual COM ports between the main control and storage unit and the AC acquisition and metering unit of smart distribution transformer combine terminal unit, two technical schemes based on HC32F4A0 MCU were proposed. Scheme one based on ring buffer and improved USB-FS device library, and scheme two based on ring-multi-buffer and DMA controller. Both schemes didn't generate receiving or sending errors in the loop receiving and sending concurrent test, in which each channel hadcommunicated more than 550 million bytes. And more tests indicate that scheme one has lower CPU load.

articleTitle: Local POI matching based on KNN and LightGBM Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: High-quality POI data is of great significance to both businesses and individuals. For businesses, POI data is advantageous for management to analyze the competitive landscape and make decisions. For individuals, the accurate location of unknown places will significantly improve the travel experience. Impressive POI matching methods assist to improve the quality of POI data. This paper proposes a novel POI matching approach, which firstly utilzes the KNN algorithm to construct local candidate sets for the problem of high global matching complexity, which significantly improves the optimization efficiency. In addition, our approach leveraging TF-IDF and BERT to re-encode the original features to improve the feature representation. Finally, we build a binary classification model based on LightGBM to improve the matching performance. The experimental results demonstrate that the approach proposed in this paper has achieved effective improvement compared to the DNN and SVM.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Technology based on pre-trained model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The pretraining model has the problems of large number of parameters, complex structure, and difficult to be compressed into a small model with both performance in practical deployment. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a lightweight entity recognition model with good performance by using the framework of knowledge distillation to supervise and guide the student entity recognition model through the teacher entity recognition model. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the method proposed in this chapter are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A new approach of modeling the ultra-short channel ballistic GAA MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Compact models are useful to avoid spending a numerous amount of time in numerical simulations which can accurately evaluate the ultra-short channel device properties. One numerical compact model proposed here is describing the drain current in ballistic mode by using one unique smoothing function representing the transmission coefficients for all operating regions. The model is addressing the compact model for the subthreshold region basing on our previous study, in which the DIBL and the SDT effects are taken into a consideration. In this paper, a method of establishing the smoothing function is introduced for expressing the important parameters in the model overall operating regions. Compared with the TCAD NEGF simulation, this proposed numerical compact model demonstrates a good agreement.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mobile Control APP for Teenagers Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of the times, the rapid development of information, the use of mobile terminals has been integrated into our lives. Because teenagers do not have good self-control ability, teenagers addiction to mobile terminals has become a major problem in the society, the market demand of teenagers anti-addiction system is large. Teenager mobile terminal control APP based on big data technology is a control APP to prevent teenagers from indulging in mobile terminals. Its front-end is developed by Java language, with Android7.0 SDK as the main technology. The back-end mainly uses SQLite embedded database as the back-end data storage. The mobile terminal control APP records the software usage of the mobile terminal. By using the deep learning technology in big data technology to extract data and portrait, the mobile terminal is controlled and managed. When teenagers use a mobile terminal for more than a certain time, the screen will automatically lock. The guardian can also set a specific time on this APP, and the mobile terminal will be automatically closed when the arrival time is reached. Even if the distance is far away, the time to play the mobile terminal can be directly controlled.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Algorithms based on the Diversion Ratio for Green 5G Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of the 5G communication systems, the consumption of base-station energy is increased significantly. In this paper, an energy saving algorithm is proposed based on the diversion ratio for communication networks, where the large-scale antenna and 5G technology are adopted. Specifically, the diversion ratio, which judges the sustainable development of operators, is firstly introduced to evaluate the resource usage efficiency of 5G wireless networks. Taking the importance of the investment efficiency into account, we propose the diversion-energy-ratio (DEO) energy saving algorithm to balance the diversion and the energy consumption of 5G networks. Simulation results verify that the proposed DEO energy saving strategy has the higher investment efficiency than the existing energy saving algorithms.

articleTitle: Ship Type Optimization in Waves Using the Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper developed an approximate ship type optimization method in waves to obtain the optimal ship hull in actual sea conditions. The sample points is obtained by Opt LHD method. The CFD method is used to calculate the total resistance and heave and pitch transfer functions of the DTMB5512 ship. The RBF model is used as the approximate model which is trained using the sample points. Finally, the multi-objective ship hull optimization method is presented using the RBF and MOPSO methods. The optimization results show that the current optimization method can obtain the optimal ship hull with the smallest total resistance and heave and pitch transfer functions.

articleTitle: A Novel Attention Ensemble Traffic Flow Prediction Model based on Spatio-Temporal big data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The emergence of intelligent transportation systems has put forward higher requirements for the problem of traffic flow prediction. Since the topology of the traffic road network changes dynamically, the traditional convolutional neural network that extracts the features of graph structure data cannot capture such dynamic features. In this paper we propose a traffic flow prediction model based on spatiotemporal characteristics to predict the traffic speed in the traffic road network. The dynamic topology structure in the traffic road network is obtained through the graph attention network (GAT), and the temporal characteristics of the data are processed by the long short-term memory network (LSTM), and the periodic characteristics of the traffic flow are captured. In this paper, the prediction model is mainly divided into space module and time module, which can capture the characteristics of traffic data in an all-round way, reduce the loss function value, and improve the prediction accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Recognition of radar in-pulse modulation based on radar de-noising Linknet
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Intra-pulse modulation pattern recognition of radar signals is an important aspect of modern electronic reconnaissance warfare. For radar intra-pulse modulated signals with low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), traditional machine learning and deep learning networks do not preprocess the signals properly, resulting in low recognition accuracy. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a semantic segmentation network-based method to improve the recognition rate of modulation patterns by preprocessing the semantics of signal time-frequency maps. The experimental results show that the method can effectively recognize 12 radar modulation patterns at low SNR, and the pattern recognition accuracy is as high as 98.6% for signals with SNR of -10db.

articleTitle: A quantitative detection method of Canny-roundness for micro defects in raw ceramic microporous machining based on infrared thermal imaging technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The nondestructive testing and evaluation of microcracks in the drilling process of raw ceramic is of great significance to improve the production quality of LTCC substrate. In this paper, based on the classical Canny operator, the microcrack images of raw porcelain extracted by CCD camera and infrared thermal imaging method are processed by optimizing gradient amplitude, automatically extracting threshold and increasing roundness detection. The analysis results of infrared thermal imaging image are compared with the processing results of high-precision CCD camera. The results show that the sensitivity of infrared thermal imaging technology to the surface microcracks of raw ceramic is higher than that of traditional high-precision CCD camera after adopting the improved canny-roundness algorithm. It can not only detect the 20 micron micro cracks on the surface of raw ceramic, but also detect the burr defects caused by laser processing in the raw ceramic.

articleTitle: Research and Construction of Image Classification Model Based on Deep Adaptive Network Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Due to the limitations of convolutional neural network in the process of image classification, this paper proposes an image classification model fused with deep multi-feature transfer network based on the existing image classification models, and improves the accuracy of image classification by optimizing the convolutional neural network model. The convolutional model optimized in this paper adopts an eight-layer network structure, and the eighth layer is regarded as an adaptive layer. The loss value of the network is about 81% accurate. Finally, the deep network adaptation algorithm is used to compare the accuracy of the two pre-training models, AlexNet and ResNet, and it is obtained that the migration rate of ResNet after adaptive layer processing is significantly higher than that of AlexNet, and the accuracy rate is increased from 75% to 80%, the classification effect is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Digital Predistortion Technique Based on Improved Gauss-Newton Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Gauss-Newton method, a common algorithm in the direct structure of digital predistortion, has a good linearization ability. However, when the predistortion model is configured with small parameters, the Hessian matrix in the Gauss-Newton method is not full rank, and the ill-conditioning problem occurs, so the search direction is not the descending direction. Therefore, this paper proposes a digital predistortion technique based on the improved Gauss-Newton method around these problems. The diagonal terms are injected into the Hessian matrix through the reference ridge regression method. A nonlinear relationship is established between them and the system error. Simulation experiments show that the improved Gauss-Newton method improves the convergence speed by 60% compared with the traditional Gauss-Newton method and reduces the normalized mean square error by 1 dB in the real RF environment.

articleTitle: Method for Speed Measurement of Small Radar Targets Based on Adaptive Signal Separation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As with the development of stealth aircrafts and micro UAV technology, the parameter measurement of small target at low altitude is becoming difficult for conventional search radar. For solving the speed measurement of small targets on background of strong clutters, an innovative method for small target speed measurement, which is based on the adaptive signal separation technique, is presented in this paper. This method can separate the signal of target from the background of strong clutter in the stagger PRF mode of conventional search radar, and then implement the parameter measurement of small targets. It has been proven in the simulation demonstration that this method is very robust to clutters and has the accuracy of speed measurement close to that obtained by Cramer-Rao Lower Bound.

articleTitle: Multi-frame Integrated Aero-engine Altitude Simulation Test Bench Data Flow Visualization Migration Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As an important method for the aero-engine performance testing, the data collected from each sensor in the process of aero-engine altitude simulation test is extremely valuable and essential. To display the data more intuitively and to explore its deeper meanings and potential value, the development of the real-time migration and visualization technology of the data flow generated from the aero-engine altitude simulation test-bed basing on multi-framework integrationis proposed. Firstly, with the help of the Mybatis-Plus automatic view layer, data stored in the bottom historical database can be visualized in the browser's table structure space using Vue framework's table structure, which provides the convincing testers to check and analyze. Then, data flow technology migration, referring to the JDBC interface based on GateWay's current limiting mechanism, integrating full/incremental data flow, and integrates multi-thread parallel transport flows using Mybatis' load balancing mechanism. Therefore, the essential information in historical database for subsequent algorithm analysis can be synchronized to local database. Finally, with Vue framework, data flow front-end monitoring interface verifies data visualization, integrity, and effectiveness in real-time.

articleTitle: A Relation Extraction Model Based on BERT Model in the Financial Regulation Field
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Relation extraction is a natural language processing (NLP) task to extract semantic relations between entities from unstructured texts, and is an important research content of constructing knowledge graph. Based on the documents issued by the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, we construct a knowledge graph in the field of financial regulation through relation extraction, which helps bank staff to realize intelligent query of regulatory documents and locate business-related regulatory requirements quickly and accurately. This paper proposes the Financial Regulation BERT (FR-BERT) model for relation extraction in the financial regulation field, aiming at the dataset's characteristics of rich semantic information of target entities, clear keywords and long texts. FR-BERT uses the BERT model to obtain sentence vector information containing each word vector, then obtains the target entity vectors and keyword vector by locating the sentence vector information, and obtains the text vector by sending the whole sentence vector information into Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM). Finally, the model uses the above vectors for classification information. FR-BERT integrates target entity vectors, keyword vector, and text vector output by BiLSTM to achieve relation extraction between entities. Compared with other relation extraction models selected in this paper, the experimental results show that FR-BERT performs better such as Macro-F1 on the relation extraction task in the financial regulation field, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Maintenance Decision-making of Tunnel Structure Based on Improved NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The tunnel structure needs to be maintained to improve its health condition. However, most of the current tunnel maintenance decision-making research is based on single-objective optimization with the constraints of minimum life cycle cost and structural performance, which cannot meet the requirements of refined maintenance. Therefore, this paper proposes a structure multi-objective maintenance decision-making model, which takes maintenance cost and the structure condition as decision-making objectives. Then NSGA-II is fused with the reverse chaotic map initialization and the adaptive crossover, adaptive mutation in this paper. The trade-off between cost and benefit can be obtained by solving the model through the improved NSGA-II. Finally, the effectiveness of the multi-objective model and the superiority of the improved NSGA-II are verified by experiment.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Circuit Test IP Core Based on OLFSR and FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As the integrated circuit design process enters the nanometer scale, the integration degree of the chip continues to improve. At the same time, the high level of integration leads to the increasingly complex design of the chip clock network. Asynchronous circuits are back on the designer's radar due to their clockless design approach. However, most of the current design tools and verification platforms are based on synchronous design. Therefore, it's important to achieve synchronous and asynchronous interactive design by using the existing synchronous design tools. By using the synchronous design tool Vivado and MicroZed development board, we propose the synthesizable asynchronous pseudo-random number generator to generate random number sequences conforming to the four-phase dual-rail protocol and the LEDR protocol, based on Optimized Linear Feedback Shift Register (OLFSR) pseudo-random number generation method. It provides convenience for the testing of synchronous and asynchronous circuits, and also provides a feasible design method process for the interactive design of synchronous and asynchronous circuits.

articleTitle: Adaptive OFDM Based on Thompson Sampling Algorithm without Channel Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In adaptive OFDM system, transmitter waveform parameters are adjusted to adapt to wireless channels. Most of the adaptation algorithm relies on prior channel information and channel estimation results. In this paper, a new adaptive OFDM scheme is proposed based on Thompson sampling (TS) algorithm without channel knowledge. In order to find out the optimal waveform in unknown channel, the proposed algorithm establishes a multi-armed bandit (MAB) reinforcement learning model, which uses the receiver feedback to explore unknown reward distribution at each frame. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can reach to the best performance within 200 frames and assure rapid convergence.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent fault location system for distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper classifies the faults occurred in the current distribution network, and designs an intelligent fault location system for distribution network. It can collect real-time current signals of three-phase lines through current transformers, receive and transmit signals using GPS, ZigBee and GPRS, judge the current through the monitoring center, determine the running state and locate the fault point. The system is of great significance to improve the automation level of power grid in China and promote the development of power grid control technology.

articleTitle: Global Attention Visual-Tactile Fusion Algorithm Based on Time Series Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A visual-tactile fusion model based on the global attention mechanism is proposed to aim at the problems of complex Spatio-temporal feature modelling and insufficient temporal feature fusion of the visual-tactile fusion algorithm. The global attention mechanism is constructed from three aspects: space, channel, and time series, which realizes the weighted fusion of Spatio-temporal features with the combination of 2D and 3D dimensions, a weighted fusion of Spatio-temporal features associated with before and after frames and the prediction of multi-class grasping states. The comprehensive comparative experiments on the GSA and Visual Tactile datasets demonstrate that the classification accuracy of the proposed model reached 83.84% and 99.05%, respectively, which verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm. This method has enlightening significance for the research and application of robot object grasping.

articleTitle: Application of Adversarial Network Model in Robot Inspection Heterophony Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid development of industrial technology, inspection robots need to monitor more and more equipment during inspection, and the demand for fault detection of equipment is increasing. It is particularly important to detect abnormal sounds of equipment such as air compressors in gas collecting stations. The deep convolutional ADversarial network is applied to the abnormal sound detection of air compressor, and the network module of optimized feature learning is introduced before the spectrograph learning of the network, and the structural similarity function is introduced to finally distinguish whether the sound is normal or not. Through simulation experiments, the improved deep convolutional adversarial network algorithm realizes abnormal sound detection of air compressor in gas collecting station, and the discrimination accuracy of abnormal sound is enhanced, which achieves the purpose of abnormal monitoring through equipment sound in actual industry.

articleTitle: Design of flexible clamping system of printing roller based on sliding mode control
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Manipulator is developed in the process of mechanization and automation of a new type of equipment, it is an important area of the industrial robot, its characteristic is that can be done by programming the default task, on the structure and properties of both human and mechanical advantage, in the modern industrial production process, the manipulator is widely used in automatic production line, now the factory a lot of the manipulator, In the flexibility may not be comparable to the real hand, but it is not afraid of fatigue, not afraid of danger, can be uninterrupted continuous work, can effectively improve industrial productivity, because of many advantages suitable for industrial production, manipulator has been widely used [1].

articleTitle: Research on survivability of spatial information network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In view of the problem that dynamic characteristics are not considered in the current research methods of survivability of spatial information networks. In this paper, based on the dynamic spatial network cumulative model based on time cumulative graph, the survivability evaluation index of dynamic network model, time-dependent network connectivity, is proposed to construct the survivability analysis method model of spatial information network. Finally, the navigation satellite network, communication satellite network and remote sensing satellite network are taken as examples to construct the space information network simulation plan, and the survivability of the space information network is analyzed. The experimental results verify the rationality of the proposed method and the effectiveness of the index.

articleTitle: Destructive Resistance Analysis of UAV Cluster Network Based on Cascade Failure Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The complex network theory is used to construct the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) cluster network and its characteristic indicators are analyzed. The cascade failure theory is used to study the destructive resistance of the UAV cluster network under different node capacities and attack information, etc. The results show that increasing the node capacity can effectively improve the network destructibility, and the cost and network performance requirements can be balanced by setting appropriate node capacity parameters; the UAV cluster network has higher destructibility under random attacks and shows vulnerability under deliberate attacks, and obtaining some important node information can also significantly reduce the network destructibility.

articleTitle: Model updating of liquid cooling plate based on response surface methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of liquid cooling plate Simplified finite element model, the DOE and sensitivity analysis of liquid cooling plate model parameters are implemented. And Full 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> Order Polynomials method is used to fit response surface model. Based on the response surface model and first three experimental modes, the Multi-objective genetic algorithm is taken to solve the objective function, in order to achieve the updated model parameters of liquid cooling plate. The errors between accurate model modal frequency and updated simplified model modal frequency of first three modes are 0.76%, 5.20%, 4.42%. The accuracy of this method is proved which can meet engineering requirement.

articleTitle: A novel Electric and Magnetic Two-Dimensionally Tunable SIW filter
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, a novel electric and magnetic two-dimensionally tuned substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) filter is presented. Ferrite and PIN tuning columns are loaded in the SIW to realize the electric and magnetic two-dimensionally tuning. Simulation results show compared with the single electric tuning, the tuning range of the filter is extended by 79% with the magnetic tuning and compared with the single magnetic tuning, the tuning range of the filter is extended by 400% with the electric tuning. The tuning range of the single tuning method is extended by the electric and magnetic two-dimensionally tunability. Compared with[17], the filter which is easier to use not need simultaneous electric and magnetic tuning.

Author Keywords: electric and magnetic tuning Classification: Microwave and millimeter wave devices

articleTitle: Recommender Systems with Two-Stream Pyramid Encoder Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Rate prediction has always been one of the most important tasks of Recommender Systems (RSs), and because of the popularity of Transformer in Deep Learning, we design a new deep learning model with Transformer to give a more accurate prediction.
