Following the idea of two-stream network, we propose a two-stream network architecture that incorporates Users' data and Item separately. Considering the new item may not have similar items in the dataset, we use feature pyramid networks (FPN) to extract a higher semantic segmentation of the item in Item-Stream. As for user data, we use Transformer block to extract the rating habit of a specific user. In this way, we reduce the prediction bias caused by different users' rating habits. In the decoder block, we jointly use the feature representations from the two-stream network to get the final rating prediction for a specific user to the new item. For different scale feature representation, we decode the feature separately and use the average value of predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that our model extracts higher level semantic information of the item. So, we overcome the problem of sparse data matrix.

articleTitle: Accurate Multipoint Synchronous Measurement Scheme of AC Electric Fields
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Based on the measured electric field data at several appropriate points adjacent to AC transmission lines, the voltages on the lines can be inversely calculated, which will greatly facilitate the condition monitoring of overhead transmission lines. The difficulty of the technique lies in the accurate synchronous measurement of multipoint electric fields. When the measurement is started by sending a command to the measuring device, there will be a problem of unsynchronization in the process of receiving and processing instructions by the measuring device, which will lead to the failure to realize the requirement of synchronous starting. And when the frequency of the oscillator crystal mounted on multiple measurement devices drifts, the synchronization accuracy of the measured electric field data is not high due to the different time rhythms, which leads to inaccurate voltage inversion. In this paper, 1PPS from the GPS receiver is used to provide a unified time standard for the measurement device. In the FPGA, the accumulation method is used to divide the 1PPS into the sampling clock of the required frequency, and the sampling pulse starts to be generated on the next 1PPS rising edge after the starting command. This scheme can not only realize the simultaneous start of acquisition by multiple measurement devices, but also reduce the time error caused by the oscillator crystal. The measurement error and its influence factors are analyzed by simulation and experiment. Finally, three electric field measurement devices are applied in the experiment, and the validity of the multipoint synchronous measurement scheme is verified.

articleTitle: Prediction of spatiotemporal sequence based on IM-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of deep learning, spatiotemporal prediction learning has many applications, such as weather prediction and human posture prediction. The continuous data question is described as a spatiotemporal sequence prediction question, in which both the input and the prediction target are spatiotemporal sequences. But the prediction of continuous frames increases the ambiguity of the image. A number of factors are known to affect the sharpness of image. Interaction between states in the network has a significant impact on sharpness of image. Based on the above discussion, the SIM (Short time interactive memory) and the LIM (Long term interactive memory) are designed. The current input and hidden states are updated by the SIM block. Memory cells and hidden states are updated by the LIM block. We built the I-LSTM unit by adding SIM and LIM to the LSTM. By stacking I-LSTM, we propose IM-LSTM (Interact memory LSTM). Experiments show the effectiveness and flexibility of our proposed method. In our experiments, we demonstrate that our proposed model accurately predicts future frames as well as other representations. It is superior to other advanced methods in index LPIPS.

articleTitle: Quantum image chaos encryption method based on multi-level wavelet transform and Fourier transform
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, a new quantum image compression and encryption algorithm is proposed by combining quantum discrete cosine transform and hyperchaotic system. The algorithm performs the quantum discrete cosine transform on the quantum grayscale image, gets the spectrum of quantum discrete cosine transform, then compresses the quantum grayscale image, and finally uses the hyperchaotic system to encrypt the compressed quantum grayscale image to get the ciphertext image. Multi-spectrum, continuous images make it difficult and burdensome to store, process and transmit image data. Image compression technology takes advantage of the redundancy of image information and the defects of human vision and other characteristics to solve the problem of image information redundancy. The combination of quantum image encryption and quantum image compression not only improves the security of quantum images but also saves network transmission bandwidth.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Analysis of Supply Chain System Based on SML Control Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to analyze and identify potential risks in the supply chain system as comprehensively as possible, this research improves the Systems Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) method and constructs a Sourcing-Making-Logistics (SML) control model. It starts from the purpose of supply chain system and obtains comprehensive and accurate risk factors by identifying the causative factors of unsafe control actions (UCA). In addition, this research successfully applied this new method to the aerospace field. The result shows that the aerospace supply chain is mainly faced with six categories of management risk, demand risk, operation risk, sourcing risk, making risk, and logistics risk. This provides a solid foundation for ensuring the stable operation of the aerospace supply chain system.

articleTitle: Fault Location Algorithm for Local Feeder Automation System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: It can accurately locate the fault of the local feeder automation power grid, close the fault area in time, and improve the transmission efficiency of the power grid. However, the traditional power grid fault location algorithm has limitations, which seriously affects the operational efficiency of the power grid and causes a lot of waste of power resources. Based on a matrix algorithm, a mathematical model of a distribution network topological region is established. Meaningless factors of fault positioning are eliminated. A time difference method in a node region is used for identifying a fault branch line. The primary positioning of the fault is realized. After the line region where the fault occurs is determined, the calculation method of the wave velocity distance measurement is used for accurately determining the fault positioning. The discrimination matrix is established to realize the location of multiple fault lines at the same time. Finally, comparative experiments are carried out. Compared with the traditional fuzzy identification algorithm, the success rate of the proposed algorithm for the power grid fault location is about twice that of the traditional algorithm. The proposed algorithm has obvious advantages in fault identification and location accuracy.

articleTitle: Tongue Image Segmentation based on An Improved Geometric Active Contour Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In view of the complexity, time-consuming and low accuracy of the existing tongue image segmentation methods, this paper proposes a new tongue image segmentation method based on an improved geometric active contour model. The algorithm uses the result of watershed transformation controlled by markers as the initial curve of the active contour model, and then uses the principle of LBF model to construct a new evolutionary stop function of geometric active contour model. Experimental results show that this method can not only reduce the influence of noise points in the image on contour deformation, but also improves the speed of convergence, and achieve satisfactory tongue image segmentation results.

articleTitle: Image-based Jointly Sparse Maximum Margin Criterion with Pairwise Constrain for Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an image-based feature extraction framework. To our best knowledge, there are few methods to combine image feature extraction and pairwise constrain (PC) jointly and directly. We fill the gap between them. With the PC, we devise an objective function, taking the PC and image feature extraction consideration jointly. Besides, we introduce maximum margin criterion into the loss function, making all positive constrains and negative constrains take part in the process of feature extraction. Finally, the solution of the new framework can be deduced into two sperate individual problems. Comprehensive experiment results show our framework effective.

articleTitle: Stealth Attacks: A Natural and Robust Physical World Attack Against Object Detectors
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Recent studies have shown the vulnerability of deep neural networks (DNNs) to adversarial examples induced by added imperceptible perturbations to the input images. Most of the attack studies focused on target classifiers, but few aimed at target detectors that are more challenging. This paper proposes a more natural and robust adversarial attack scheme against practical object detectors. First, we extract the target area through image semantic segmentation, and perturbations are only added to the extracted target area to generate more practical adversarial examples. Then, style transfer is adopted to make the generated adversarial examples more natural-looking. Finally, we improve our robustness against adversarial examples by simulating angle, lighting, distance, and background changes. Our generated adversarial examples have proved more successful and robust in adversarial attacks than other methods. This paper sheds light on the potential threat of adversarial examples to the real physical world and hopefully provides guidance for defending against such natural and robust adversarial example attacks.

articleTitle: Dual-channel SAR slow moving target detection method based on multi-look and magnitude-phase joint
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the detecting difficulty and imaging the slow moving target submerged in clutter and noise, a dual-channel SAR slow moving target detection method based on multi-look and magnitude-phase joint is proposed. Firstly, according to statistical analysis of interferogram's phase and magnitude PDF distribution, a new metrics is established by combining the variable of interferogram's phase transformation with interferogram's magnitude. Then, the new metrics is processed by multi-look. Finally, slow moving target can be effectively detected by a given CFAR threshold. Experiments show the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Crack Propagation Based on Computer Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Based on the computer numerical simulation software ABAQUS, this paper uses the extended finite element correlation module to establish a test block model with four prefabricated through cracks, and carries out the numerical simulation of uniaxial compression and biaxial compression respectively. Further understand and analyze the crack initiation, propagation and final failure form of the sample with crack model, and deeply study the mechanism of crack initiation, propagation and penetration. The research shows that: In the process of crack propagation under uniaxial compression, the crack propagation rate is relatively fast in the early propagation steps, then the crack propagation gradually slows down; With the increase of crack inclination, the crack propagation degree decreases and the area with large stress is mainly concentrated at the crack tip.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Grey Factor Analysis in Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Predictive analysis is one of the most important application fields of big data analytics, which can predict uncertain events by combining various advanced analysis functions, especially statistical analysis and other methods. Big data analytics technology is mainly applied in business intelligence, government decision-making, public services and so on. Factor analysis is one of the methods in classical statistics, which can only give the distribution degree and variation of data based on the mean value, and can not reflect the characteristics of data objects changing with time, so it is not suitable for solving the statistical analysis problem of big data objects based on time series. In order to make up for the deficiency of factor analysis of big data with time series, according to the characteristics of time series in grey system, that is, grey system theory devotes itself to the discussion of realistic laws through the generation and development of sequences, while mathematical statistics devotes itself to the study of statistical historical laws. Combining the advantages of grey system and classical factor analysis, this paper proposed a new model, namely grey factor analysis applied on bigdata analysis layer, and implemented systematically by using object-oriented programming method. Finally, this method is applied to big data analytics. The results are analyzed and compared, and the effect is remarkable and best forecasting. The experimental results show that this method has promoted the analysis and research of big data with time series, and plays an important role in refining the value of complicated massive data, predictive analysis and data mining forms to help the government better understand the data and draw predictive decisions according to the results of data mining.

articleTitle: Concurrency and Parallelism in Speeding Up I/O and CPU-Bound Tasks in Python 3.10
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Modern data storage systems often fetch data from a large number of sources. Although synchronous data transfer is simple as it can use simple scheduling of data delivery, it scales poorly. This paper reports our investigations on asynchronous data transfer and processing aiming to substantially improve the system efficiency. The implementation assumes the most recent version of Python programming language, and exploits concurrency and parallelism provided by the relevant Python modules. In particular, asyncio module can be used to parallelize massive I/O requests, multiprocess module is useful to increase the throughput of CPU-bound tasks, and concurrent futures module offers concurrency and parallelism of jobs. The observed speed up compared to a baseline synchronous programming is significant, and it can yield between 77 to 96% reduction in the required overall runtime depending on the specific modules and functions used on a single multi-core CPU.

articleTitle: Uplink interference mitigation technology for NGSO constellation systems based on optimal spatial isolation Angle
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, we study the frequency coexistence problem between NGSO constellation systems of global distributed earth stations, and propose a specific method to mitigate uplink interference of NGSO constellation systems by optimizing the access strategy of earth stations to achieve the optimal spatial isolation Angle, and find the optimal spatial isolation Angle by solving a nonlinear programming problem. Simulation results show that the proposed method reduces the cumulative probability of harmful interference time between NGSO constellation systems while ensuring the received signal level.

articleTitle: The Mechanism Thinking of Unmanned Cluster Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The unmanned cluster operation driven by AI is a new type of combat. Yet lack of knowledge about the mechanism of unmanned cluster operation, will do no help to master the key of such combat. In this article, some work had been done to explore the relative mechanism, including the winning mechanism in intelligence epoch, principle of command and control in dealing with complexity, and the intelligence principle for AI. Those work can be used to explain “why need unmanned cluster operation”, “how to conduct unmanned cluster operation”, “what benefits can get”, “what the unmanned cluster operation will be in future”, as a result, the unmanned cluster operation method will be further deepened and ripened.

articleTitle: Analysis of UAV-based RF Energy Harvesting Wireless Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper investigates a novel UAV-based wireless communication system combined with energy harvesting and NOMA. All UAVs are served as dynamic small base stations and connect with the main base station in a given area. The unit time slot is split into two phases: the downlink (DL) phase for energy harvesting and the uplink phase for data transmission (uplink). In other words, users (UEs) will first gather energy from all UAVs and main base station transmissions before using that energy to provide uplink information transmission. To address the problems, this paper considers both inter-cell and intra-cell interference in the throughput calculation. The UVA-based system solved the inter-cell interference, which plays an important role in the performance of total system throughput in previous work. The simulations in this paper match the numerical analysis results and show that there exists an optimal <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$T$</tex> to achieve the maximum throughput. In addition, it also shows that the system throughput increases significantly based on our new system model.

articleTitle: Avalanche Capability Characterization of Si MOSFETs in Unclamped Inductive Switching Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The avalanche capability of Si MOSFETs with different power sizes is experimentally compared and analyzed in this paper. The variation of device current and voltage during the avalanche of Si MOSFET is reported. Use temperature-sensitive parameters to calculate the change in junction temperature during the device avalanche. The comparison shows that in the same package, the smaller R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS(on)</inf>, the better the avalanche capability of the device. The avalanche capability of the device is related to the heat dissipation capability of the device. In tests with different inductance sizes, it is concluded that the ability of the device to dissipate heat at large inductances is the main factor affecting the avalanche tolerance of the device.

articleTitle: Low-light Image Enhancement Network via Pyramid and Residual Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Images taken under weak illumination conditions usually suffer from low brightness and complex degradation. Most existing low-light image enhancement approaches cannot effectively eliminate the complicated degradation. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stage low-light image enhancement network based on Pyramid Architecture and Residual Attention. In the first stage, we employ a pyramid brightness enhancement module to capture the illumination differences in the low-light image through the receptive field range of different scales. This stage can avoid the problems of over-exposure and under-exposure and produce satisfactory brightness-enhanced images. In the second stage, we propose a degradation repair module that combines U-Net and residual attention block. This stage can effectively deal with multiple degradation factors after enhancing the contrast of low-light images. Experiments conducted on the LOL real-world and LIME, DICM datasets demonstrate that our proposed model outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in terms of brightness enhancement and degradation recovery.

articleTitle: Research on detection technology of water accumulation in ultrasonic steel pipe rod based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In view of the increasingly prominent problems of water accumulation and inner wall corrosion of steel pipe poles in the power grid, a Digital Signal Processing (DSP)-based ultrasonic water accumulation detection system in steel pipe rods is proposed. The ultrasonic technology is used to pop up quickly and data analysis is strong. Water accumulation detection, timely detection of internal water accumulation and corrosion, and improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of steel pipe rods.

articleTitle: A Multidimensional Fingerprint Positioning Method using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Fingerprint positioning is an effective positioning method for a rich scattering indoor environment. Most fingerprint positioning methods are based on the received signal strength (RSS). However, as a coarse-grained parameter, RSS may fluctuate at a fixed position, making the positioning results unstable. The recent advanced positioning systems use the amplitude information of channel state information (CSI) instead of RSS. Yet the non-line-of-sight (NLOS) environment limits their applicable scene. This paper proposes a dispersion maximization least squares support vector machine (DM-LSSVM)-based multi-dimensional fingerprint positioning model that can work in an NLOS environment. We first use a Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC) algorithm to estimate the angle-of-arrival (AoA) and multipath number, and then a multi-dimensional fingerprint library is built by combining the RSS value with the estimated AoA and multipath number. Finally, we introduce the LSSVM as the positioning algorithm to realize positioning and calculate the weight of each fingerprint through the dispersion maximization method, implement a method which can enhance the positioning accuracy of AoA in NLOS scenarios through RSS and multipath numbers. The result shows that in a high NLOS deployment environment, the median accuracy is 0.38m.

articleTitle: Optimal design of transmission device for wind power installation ship lifting system based on continuous variables and discrete neighborhoods
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The traditional design of the transmission device of the lifting system of the wind power installation ship is complex, and the final design scheme obtained by the general optimization method is generally not the best. Therefore, the establishment of the generalized mathematical optimization model of this kind of transmission is discussed, and a discrete neighborhood optimization strategy based on continuous variable optimization results is proposed. On this basis, the optimization solution is carried out by taking the transmission device of an offshore wind power installation ship as an example.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Steel-Tube-Confined Concrete-Filled Square Steel Tubes Column Under Axial Compression Based on Abaqus Software
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to improve the mechanical performance of concrete-filled square steel tubular columns, the steel-tube-confined concrete-filled square steel tube (TCFST) column is formed by adding steel tubes around the concrete-filled square steel tube columns. The numerical model is established by computer simulation technology based on Abaqus software, and the stress analysis is carried out. The ultimate bearing capacity of steel-tube-confined concrete-filled square steel tubes column is predicted by BP neural network model. The results show that the bearing capacity and deformation capacity of concrete-filled square steel tube column can be improved by using steel tube confined concrete column. When the outer steel tube is confined by circular steel tube, the total bearing capacity of the concrete-filled square steel tube (SCFST) column is increased by 60.6%, respectively, compared with the unconfined concrete-filled square steel tube column. The prediction results of the bearing capacity of the specimens by the BP neural network model are in good agreement with the finite element and experimental results, which verifies the effectiveness of the BP neural network model.

articleTitle: Efficient Clutter Suppression by SOM-SMOTE Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Radar clutters have complex distribution in space, time and frequency domains especially under complex environment. In the complex geographical environment, radar will produce a large number of clutter residues. Therefore, we designed a clutter suppression method based on intelligent classification. This method constructs high-dimensional feature vectors of radar echo signals, and uses SOM-SMOTE Random Forest (SOM-SMOTE-RF) to identify clutter. In order to solve the problem of data set imbalance, we propose SOM-SMOTE method, which combines self-organizing mapping (SOM) with synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE). The actual data shows that SOM-SMOTE-RF clutter recognition rate ≥92%.

articleTitle: Support Vector Guided Locally Aggregated Descriptors for Feature Encoding
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Feature encoding, as a crucial component of image categorization, has been widely investigated in recent works. Among all kinds of encoding strategies, the vector of locally aggregated descriptors (VLAD) and its extensions have gained a lot of attentions and provide a brand-new framework, aggregating the deviations between a set of descriptors and their average distribution. However, the VLAD-like frameworks only utilize statistics to represent the deviations, which may not achieve the optimal discrimination for classification tasks. In this paper, we propose the support vector guided locally aggregated descriptors (SVGLAD) to leverage the residuals of support vectors between descriptors and clusters of the dataset, which can preserve more geometric information. We validate the effectiveness of our methods on two image datasets (15-Scenes and PASCAL VOC 2007). The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the existing coding algorithms.

articleTitle: Application of BP neural network in air quality prediction model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: An important prerequisite for air pollution control is a more scientific and accurate prediction of the air quality index. In this paper, we first construct an air quality prediction model by BP neural network technique; then combine the variable screening method to optimize the independent variables in the input elements of the model, and finally select the variables that have the main influence on the air quality prediction model based on the test results. In this paper, taking Beijing as an example, we select the day-by-day data of air quality index and the day-by-day data of meteorological factors from 2017 to 2020, and apply the improved model for air quality prediction, and from the simulation results, it can be seen that the improved model using the variable screening method can improve the accuracy of predicting air quality index compared with BP neural network. The optimization of the model improves the validity of the prediction and can provide the scientific basis for subsequent air pollution prediction work and research.

articleTitle: Production Method of Light Field Image Simulation Based on 3ds Max 3D Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: At present, there are various ways to implement a light field imaging system, among which light field array camera as a new system of the light field imaging system is widely concerned and researched, however, the light field image produced based on this method does not provide the demand of scene baseline changeable, which greatly limits the application scene of light field image. To this end, this paper proposes a light field image simulation production method based on 3ds Max 3D reconstruction, which mainly includes five key steps, including 3D scene modeling, scene unit configuration, lighting parameter adjustment, array camera construction, and rendering imaging. The method proposed in this paper solves the shortcomings of the traditional light field image production process that cannot target array camera baseline changes and has advantageous features such as stable camera parameters, idealized rendering imaging, variable imaging baseline, and simultaneous presentation of a depth map. Compared with the traditional method, the method produces images with balanced quality and high automation, which can effectively improve the production efficiency of light field images in specific scenes and meet the requirements of relevant light field image processing tasks.

articleTitle: Design of a near-spherical digital phased array with a large coverage
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In view of the requirements of multi-target reception, large space coverage and equipment miniaturization of receiving terminals for low-orbit satellites, this paper has analyzed and designed the optimal array arrangement and element design. By utilizing the near-spherical array arrangement and crossed multi-layer distribution, the array efficiency has been effectively improved and the uniform coverage of a large space area has been obtained. Furthermore, the sparse array with a higher gain has been achieved by proposing the cavity-backed array element. The simulated and measured results have confirmed that the proposed array has achieved a large coverage of −8°∼90° in the elevation plane and the G/T fluctuation is less than 1dB. Moreover, the side-lobe level is around −15dB with a uniform weighting.

articleTitle: A novel fully homomorphic robust secret sharing scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: As an enhancement to traditional secret sharing, robust secret sharing provides additional fault tolerance. The fault tolerance means that the original secret can be recovered even if some shares used in reconstruction are incorrect. So far, there is a lot of research work on robust secret sharing, however the current schemes are all based on Shamir's scheme. Because Shamir's scheme is constructed on polynomials, it has only additive homomorphism and has a narrow range of applications. In this article, we will analyze the existence of robust secret sharing scheme based on Chinese Remainder Theorem from the perspective of redundant residue number system. Based on the existence, we construct a new robust secret sharing scheme and we analyze the time complexity, share size, robustness and homomorphism of our scheme. Compared with the existing scheme, our new scheme has both additive and multiplicative homomorphisms under the premise of achieving the same robustness and share size.

articleTitle: Comparing Stable Manifold and backward reachable set Method for Estimating the Region of Attraction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Numerous computational methods have been proposed for estimating the region of attraction (ROA) within the Mathematics, Power systems and Control community. In this paper, we consider the determination of the boundary of the ROA using the stable manifolds and the estimation of the ROA as backward reachable sets using a Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs partial differential equation. The stable manifolds methods discretize the ROA (or the boundary of the ROA) into a finite union of geometric elements and store them directly. The essential idea of the backward reachable set method is to present the ROA implicitly, meaning that it is feasible to find the ROA as the level set of some function of the state space variables. The stable manifold and backward reachable set method are compared and discussed through investigating numerical example.

articleTitle: The six-degree-of-freedom robotic arm optimization iterative learning algorithm improves trajectory planning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Among the many fields covered by artificial intelligence (AI), path planning is undoubtedly one of the problems involving a wide range of research areas. Being able to find an optimal solution that allows the robot to establish a safe and effective way to get from the initial state to the final state is a challenge for continuing research today. The increasingly widespread use of robots has made path planning an important aspect of integrating these systems into countless applications. Therefore, taking a 6-DOF manipulator as an example, the mathematical model of working motion of the 6-DOF manipulator was established according to the optimization iterative learning algorithm, and the forward and inverse kinematics were analyzed. In path PLANNING, THE FAST SCALING BASED RANDOM TREE and bidirectional scaling BALANCED connected biTREE path planning method are combined to realize the high-dimensional and complex constraints of non-conflict path planning. The simulation results are in good agreement with the calculation results, which verifies that the structure of the model is consistent with the calculation method, and provides a useful reference for the design of similar manipulator.

Author Keywords: six degrees of freedom robotic arm

articleTitle: Consensus control and network communication for MAS
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, the User Datagram Protocol (UDP) is used for network communication between MAS, and an applicable consensus control algorithm is derived. Using the consensus control algorithm, the velocities of MAS including two real robots and three virtual robots tend to have consensus. The proposed algorithm is verified by simulation and experimental results, it proves that the deduced algorithm has more effective improvements than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on economic risk model of global value chain based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the deepening of economic globalization, the economic ties between countries in the world are becoming increasingly close. Many countries have completed vertical division of labor and cooperation. A global value chain is a state in which each country undertakes the production of part of the product, and uses foreign intermediate products to complete the final product and export it, thereby promoting the formation of a global value chain. Based on the analysis of the shape of the global value chain, this research uses an algorithm to establish an economic risk prediction model to achieve economic risk trend prediction and provide theoretical support for global value chain economic risk avoidance.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of small Ku-band SAR stabilization platform
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) has all-day and all-weather characteristics, and has broad application prospects in many fields. As an important part of the SAR system, the stable platform plays an important role in the SAR imaging effect. Through the derivation of the stability principle of the gyro stabilized platform, a small and low-cost SAR stable platform based on MEMS Gyro is designed. ARM is used as the control core, servo motor and photoelectric encoder are used as the driving and feedback components, and the stability, control accuracy and rapid response ability of the system are improved through the fusion of the stability loop, position loop and speed loop and the improved PID control algorithm. It has good engineering application and promotion value.

articleTitle: A Ship Recognition Method Based on RBM Network and Its Performance Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the wide application of RATR technology and the urgent need for sea surface target recognition, RATR technology has played an important role in various marine activities in recent years. In the ship recognition task, HRRP can provide more target information, and data is easier to obtain and process than SAR, ISAR and other two-dimensional imaging technologies. Therefore, under the above background, this paper proposes an automatic target recognition method based on RBM depth learning network for ship recognition of radar high resolution range profile. The performance of the model is verified by the measured data of 10 types of military and civilian ship targets. According to the features extracted from the network, four different classifiers DBN, SVM, AGC and MCC are used for classification tests. The results show that network is relatively stable under the four classifiers, and DBN has the highest recognition rate. In addition, after verification, the network has a certain ability to reject the samples outside the library, which indicates it has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Multi-layer Heterogeneous Data Management Architecture for Space Experiment Command And Display System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Aiming at the command and display system's original data traceability, historical data availability, real-time data high reliability, and heterogeneous environment adaptable command display data management requirements, a multi-layer heterogeneous data management architecture is proposed. The architecture includes a data unstructured persistence layer, a structured persistence layer, a structured cache layer and a localized cache layer. Multiple data management layers can be flexibly combined to provide services according to the usage requirements and resource conditions of the command and display system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automation Control System for Photovoltaic Modules Coating
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The aging and damage of the coating are the major factors that decrease the photoelectric conversion efficiency of PV modules in outdoor environment. A feasible solution is to coat a new anti-reflection film on PV modules. In this paper, an automation control system for coating device of PV modules is designed, which can operate intelligently on the PV modules without manual intervention. The spraying module, walking mechanism and linear drive unit of the coating device are dynamically allocated through the designed control system based on the coating procedure. The experimental results show that the system can automatically control the device to accomplish the coating process of the whole PV modules and solve the problems including uneven coating thickness, low utilization rate of coating solution, and high work intensity in manual coating methods.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation index system of organizational effectiveness based on multi-integrated and highly elastic energy Internet enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous construction of a multi-integrated and highly flexible power grid and the deepening of the reform of “delegating power, regulating and serving”, the pace of optimization and adjustment of energy Internet enterprises has gradually accelerated. This paper analyzes the internal and external needs of energy Internet companies to carry out organizational effectiveness evaluation, summarizes the relevant theories of efficiency evaluation, and studies and constructs an index system for energy Internet enterprise organizational performance evaluation. Provide technical methods.

articleTitle: An impulsive noise mitigation method based on all subcarriers assisted gaussian generalized approximate message passing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In many orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) communication scenarios, impulsive noise can severely degrade communication performance. In this paper, we propose an impulsive noise mitigation method based on gaussian generalized approximate message passing-sparse Bayesian learning (GGAMP-SBL) by exploiting all subcarriers. The algorithm achieves accurate estimation of impulsive noise without any prior information and with relatively low complexity. The simulation results show that the algorithm performs well in terms of mean square error and normalized mean square error performance of impulsive noise estimation and bit error rate performance.

articleTitle: Video description method based on sentence semantics and length loss calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The KL divergence loss function commonly used in existing models can represent a single mapping relationship of length distribution by learning specific visual content features, but it cannot accurately predict the length distribution of sentences in a one-to-many mapping relationship, resulting in the description of semantic information. incomplete. Second, the loss is calculated using a character-level negative log-likelihood function, ignoring sentence-level semantics, resulting in inaccurate semantic information of the generated descriptions. In this paper, a new length loss function is designed to adaptively adjust the error penalty by measuring the distance between the prediction and the reference length, so that the model can learn the optimal description length distribution in highly similar visual content. Secondly, through the semantic hidden state calculation of the decoding layer, a description generation loss function based on sentence semantics is designed, and the optimal sentence semantic description is iteratively obtained by comparing the semantics of the prediction and the reference description at the sentence level. The experimental results show that the model is tested on the MSVD and MSR-VTT datasets, and various indicators are significantly improved, which are better than the existing models.

articleTitle: Atmospheric monitoring path optimization based on improved discrete cuckoo search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an improved discrete cuckoo search algorithm based on the spatial clustering for flight path optimization of atmospheric monitoring in industrial parks. This paper also optimizes the local operator and proposes the acceptance of the redesigned solution based on the Metropolis criterion to reduce the possibility of easily falling into local optimum. The standard TSPLIB library is selected for algorithm simulation and performance test in the analysis case, and the superiority of the algorithm is verified by comparing and analyzing with the standard discrete cuckoo search algorithm and particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, integration of improved trajectory optimization algorithms with the actual built UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) atmospheric monitoring platform, and the feasibility of the proposed flight path optimization algorithm is verified in an outdoor environment.

articleTitle: Research on well capacity prediction algorithm based on improved sparrow search algorithm fused with SVR
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: China is a large industrial country. In the process of oilfield development, it is of great significance to predict and analyze the oil well productivity of the oilfield. Aiming at the problems that sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is easy to fall into local optimization, insufficient search space and slow convergence speed when dealing with complex optimization problems, this paper proposes an improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA) and integrates it into the training of support vector regression (SVR), so as to avoid the problems of local optimization and over fitting caused by improper selection of initial parameters of support vector regression machine, The accuracy of oil well production capacity prediction is improved, and the oil field production data is used for comparative analysis and verification.

articleTitle: Excitation Processing of Self-Oscillating Fluxgate Based on Improved Empirical Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Self-oscillating fluxgates are widely used in current measurements because of their advantages in cost and other factors. And the excitation processing can play an important role in affecting the sensors' performance. This paper proposes to apply the improved empirical wavelet transform (IEWT) to the exciting signal processing of self-oscillating fluxgate to achieve adaptive demodulation and effective filtering. And to adjust the characteristic of exciting current, the paper uses frequency domain envelope processing to achieve an accurate selection of the main frequency points. The extraction of the detected signal in the low-frequency band is accomplished by the sub-band weights set. The exciting current is adaptively decomposed into several modes by the IEWT, and the low-frequency mode can directly correspond to the detected current, while the high-frequency mode can accurately determine the saturation of the magnetic core. The feasibility of the method is demonstrated by the simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of ZigBee-Based Multi-Sensor IoT Wireless Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid progress of urban transport construction across the country, the overall number of traffic signals has increased dramatically. Signal failures due to imperfect signal system construction and inadequate operation and maintenance management also occur from time to time. This paper introduces the principles and application features of Zig Bee wireless communication technology and discusses the design and implementation of a traffic signal O&M system based on this technology to aid fault monitoring and traffic accident prevention.

articleTitle: Embedding-based neural network for investment return prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In addition to being familiar with policies, high investment returns also require extensive knowledge of relevant industry knowledge and news. In addition, it is necessary to leverage relevant theories for investment to make decisions, thereby amplifying investment returns. A effective investment return estimate can feedback the future rate of return of investment behavior. In recent years, deep learning are developing rapidly, and investment return prediction based on deep learning has become an emerging research topic. This paper proposes an embedding-based dual branch approach to predict an investment's return. This approach leverages embedding to encode the investment id into a low-dimensional dense vector, thereby mapping high-dimensional data to a low-dimensional manifold, so that high-dimensional features can be represented competitively. In addition, the dual branch model realizes the decoupling of features by separately encoding different information in the two branches. In addition, the swish activation function further improves the model performance. Our approach are validated on the Ubiquant Market Prediction dataset. The results demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to Xgboost, Lightgbm and Catboost.

articleTitle: Wearable physiological monitoring system for sheep
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In sheep breeding and management, it is important to be able to collect the physiological parameters of sheep quickly and easily. The traditional manual measurement methods have problems such as poor real-time, low accuracy and inconvenience. In order to collect the body temperature and heart rate of sheep in real time, effectively and remotely, and provide scientific basis for corresponding disease diagnosis and delivery period prediction, a wearable physiological monitoring device for sheep is designed in this paper. The hardware system is powered by a lithium battery and uses the STM32F103C8T6 minimal system as the microprocessor, combined with the MLX90614 infrared temperature sensor and the AD8232 ECG acquisition module. The sensor transmits the collected physiological parameters of the sheep to the microprocessor, and the microprocessor receives the data and packages the corresponding parameters through the GPRS wireless transmission module via the MQTT protocol to send to the The microprocessor receives the data and sends the corresponding parameters to the server via GPRS wireless transmission module via MQTT protocol. The server uses a limit-average filtering algorithm to correct the body temperature signal, and proposes a comprehensive filtering method based on elliptic filter and FIR for the baseline drift, inotropic interference and industrial frequency interference of ECG signal. According to the filtered ECG signal, the heart rate value of sheep can be calculated. The results show that this system can automatically and effectively collect and transmit the body temperature and heart rate signals of sheep, and the integrated filtering algorithm designed in this paper can effectively filter out the interference and provide technical support for monitoring the physiological signals of sheep.

articleTitle: A Novel Portable Apple Non-destructive Testing System Based on Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This study mainly takes apples as the research object, and uses near-infrared spectroscopy as the means to establish the relationship model between the reflected light and sugar content of apples. The objective is to implement the optical detection concept to achieve non-destructive fruit sugar content detection using cellphones. This technique increases the speed of detection, lowers the cost of detection, and effectively supports the management of fruits both before and after production.

articleTitle: A Direct-coupled Harmonic Rejection Mixer Employing IIP3 Improving Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper introduces a high linearity, low power wideband harmonic rejection mixer (HRM). By fully utilizing the modified differential multiple gated transistor (DMGTR) technique, a novel direct-coupled high linearity HRM is proposed. Implemented in a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.18-\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> CMOS process, and the current consumption is 6.20 mA under one 1.8-V supply. The measurements show that a 1.458-dB peak conversion gain, a 16.21-dBm IIP3, a 37.55-dBc 3rd harmonic rejection ratio (HRR) and a 67.52-dBc 5th HRR is obtained for a wide frequency range.

articleTitle: NUIFFT-RFT: A Novel Coherent Accumulation Method for Frequency agile Radar
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Frequency agile radar is difficult to coherently integrate the target echo signal due to amplitude and phase fluctuations caused by frequency changes. In this paper, we propose a novel signal coherent accumulation method based on Non-uniform IFFT and RFT(Radon-Fourier transform), namely NUIFFT-RFT. After exploiting RFT to compensate the movement between pulses, NUIFFT is utilized to achieve fast coherent accumulation between randomly changing frequency signals. The simulation of small volume targets shows that NUIFFT-RFT improves the accumulation performance evidently and reduces the computational complexity significantly.

articleTitle: IPC-loss: A fine-grained processor performance analyze method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: CPI stacks is an effectively way to analyze the design bottlenecks of processor cores. However, conventional CPI stacks models always analyze the performance of the processor based on the global status via selecting a typical event as the cause of the stall in one cycle, which may lead to inaccurate analysis of the actual design bottlenecks. Based on conventional CPI stacks, this paper proposes a performance analysis method based on Instructions per Cycle loss (IPC-loss). This method points out the main contents of processor that needed to be optimized via obtaining the instruction loss of each pipeline stage, and fine-grained analysis the bottlenecks of processor via other method including CPI stacks of each stage. By experiments on gem5 simulator, the IPC-loss analysis method proved to be helpful for processor design analysis.

articleTitle: Cautosim-based Parsing and Preservation Methods for the Modelica Language
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper describes a model processing method for Modelica grammars in Cautosim software. In the use of the Cautosim software, the model is checked for grammatical legality. If the check passes, the model content is read and fed into the grammar parsing tool to form a grammar tree. From the grammar tree, the text is instantiated and the target instance is generated and displayed in the software in a visual format. Nowadays, with the rapid development of science and technology, electronic measurement technology, as an important part of electronic information, has undergone tremendous changes. As a powerful electronic measuring instrument, oscilloscope is widely used in communication industry, aerospace and other fields. The main function of the oscilloscope is to measure the input signal and display its time distribution characteristics in the form of waveform. Due to different principles, there are two different types of oscilloscopes, analog and digital. In terms of function, the analog oscilloscope has no data storage function, so it is unable to analyze the data, and the triggering function is also very limited. In addition, many analog devices are used in the analog oscilloscope, which will have unstable performance and other problems with the change of the surrounding environment. The digital oscilloscope is generally small, portable, and can store waveforms for a long time. It can compare waveforms and process data later. It has a variety of trigger methods and powerful data analysis and processing capabilities. Therefore, in the current market, with the continuous development of digital oscilloscopes, digital oscilloscopes have occupied a leading position.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sampling Saliency Detection Based on Content Selective Mapping
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of local contrast-based saliency detection algorithm and obtain accurate saliency detection maps, this paper proposes an adaptive sampling saliency detection method based on selective mapping of image content. We transform the Gaussian differential feature spectrum into the spatial domain to produce a density mapping scatter plot that resembles the distribution of human eye gaze points. According to the generated density scatter plot, the randomly generated initial sampling windows are moved to the most salient object position by Mean-shift to achieve adaptive sampling. It simulates eye movement switching. Moreover, we extract image edges by super-pixel segmentation as a reference to get more background prior features, which can further complementary fuse with the foreground information from the sampling feature map by PCA to generate the saliency map with adequate details. Experiments show that the proposed adaptive sampling mechanism is effective and outperforms existing region detection approaches, while our method with good performance is verified on four publicly available datasets.

articleTitle: Health management of coal storage, transportation and loading equipment based on predictive maintenance with vibration perception
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: For various types of motors in the storage and transportation system of the coal industry, by using IO link intelligent sensor, IO link master/ edge gateway, AI Artificial Intelligence and data processing technology, the online vibration monitoring, early fault warning and diagnosis system is established, so as to finally realize the predictive maintenance and health management of equipment.

articleTitle: Optimizing Computer Processing Technology Using RC Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In computer hardware, processors known as multiply-accumulate operation, MAC, compute the addition of a sum of products. MAC plays a vital role in calculating and transferring digital information. As technology advances, the computational hardware must become more efficient. As a result, this paper examined the prospect of optimizing MAC operations using RC circuits. To understand the potential of using RC circuits as architecture, this paper investigated by extrapolating the circuit formulas, errors, and dependencies of variables. In designing circuits with input variables, data were collected to interpret the effectiveness of the circuitry. Through the testing of dependence in time, voltage, or resistance, whether as fixed or changing variables, the results show a positive relationship between the number of bitlines and the number of bits representable by the circuit. The fundamentals of circuitry design are crucial to understanding and expanding modern advancements in circuit MAC operations. As a result, the basic functions of every technological processing chip are continuously upgraded using the optimal selection of fundamental variables. To help with the expanding advancement, the results from this paper hope to construct and aid more advanced research within the hardware field in the future.

articleTitle: Closed-Form Noise Resilient Solution for Moving Target Localization in Multistatic System Without Nuisance Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Moving target localization is a vital research subject of signal processing for the multistatic system. Previous closed-form solutions usually introduce redundant parameters to pseudo-linearize the measurement equations. This type of operation brings in extra estimation error, albeit it is partially corrected with an additional stage, which results in diverging the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) if the noise is large. We formulate a projection matrix to eliminate the nuisances and obtain the initial solution in terms of the least squares (LS) criterion. Then, the initial solution is modified in another stage according to the weighted least square (WLS) technique. The proposed estimator is asymptotically unbiased and can achieve the CRLB in both theory and simulations under mild noise levels, and it is superior to the other algebraic solutions when the noise is large.

articleTitle: Chaotic Optimization Research of Unmanned Seabed Prospecting Vehicle Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In order to make the unmanned seabed prospecting vehicle have fast and accurate tracking track, this paper adopts the control mode of speed ring and position ring in series connection, the speed inner ring uses fuzzy controller, and the position outer ring uses fuzzy neural network controller. The parameters of the two controllers are set by chaotic off-line optimization algorithm to optimize the control performance of the system. Experiments show that the unmanned seabed prospecting vehicle system using chaos optimization can achieve good response speed and tracking performance, and the control quality is excellent.

articleTitle: Research on Microwave Energy Beam Control Technology with Clear Field Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the problem of beam direction control in the process of microwave wireless energy transmission from the solar power station in space orbit to the ground, a method for accurately measuring the transmission deflection angle of the energy beam with a clear field distribution is studied, which can improve the transmission efficiency of microwave energy and reduce the energy overflow loss. At present, the key point of energy beam control technology is to measure the beam transmission deflection angle. Different from the previous beam transmission direction control based on the phase of energy beam, this paper starts from the field distribution of energy beam with Gaussian distribution and solves the problem from the perspective of field strength measurement. By constructing a space rectangular coordinate system and arranging field strength detection points, the geometric relationship between the transmitting antenna, receiving antenna and field strength detection points is studied, and the beam center coordinates when the energy beam is transmitted to the ground are derived, so that the beam transmission deflection angle can be obtained. On this basis, a simulation experiment is designed to verify the proposed method, and the results show that the measurement error of beam deflection is less than 0.02°. The method proposed in this paper can meet the technical requirement that the beam deflection measurement error is less than 0.02° during the wireless transmission of microwave energy. This method can provide a reference for the beam control technology of space solar power station.

articleTitle: Research on short text entity disambiguation based on entity type classification
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Entity disambiguation is an effective method to solve the problem of multi-meaning words in language. Due to the length of the short text, most models can not accurately understand the contextual semantic information of ambiguous words. In view of the above difficulties, this paper constructed the entity disambiguation model based on BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), and proposed a semantic enhancement method to solve the problem of insufficient semantics after feature extraction. The starting and ending position vectors of linked text type values were extracted from the output results of BERT model and input to the full connection layer. In order to optimize the effect of existing short-text entity disambiguation model, an auxiliary entity disambiguation model method was proposed. After obtaining the results of entity disambiguation model, The Entity Type Classification (ETC) model is introduced to integrate with the original Entity disambiguation model to further proofread the results of Entity disambiguation and correct some entities incorrectly linked by Entity disambiguation model. Experimental results show that compared with the original model, the proposed method improves the F1 values of CCKS2019 and CCKS2020 by 2.16% and 1.07%, respectively, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A data-driven method for evaluating the operating status of the equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Data-driven evaluation and warning method for equipment is one of the approaches for modern enterprises to realize intelligent manufacturing. Compared with the traditional method, the data-driven method has the advantages of better responsiveness and higher accuracy, so it has attracted extensive attention. This paper proposes a new method or process to assess the operational status of equipment with time-varying and two-stage characteristics. Taking the evaluation of injection molding machine as an example, the results show that this data-driven evaluation method can reduce the early-warning rate by about 72% compared with the direct principal component analysis method.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of Software Bug Reports Based on LDA and Word2Vec
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Obtaining the types of software faults is of great significance for fault location and repair. Usually, manual classification methods are expensive. In this paper, we propose an automatic classification framework for Bug Reports based on LDA and Word2Vec. The feature representation of common classification methods has the problems of data sparsity and high dimensionality, so this paper adopts the feature representation method that combines LDA and Word2vec, which can represent words as low-dimensional word vectors with semantic relationships. Furthermore, to improve the quality of the classification model, we introduce the Self-Attention mechanism. The results show that the framework can automatically classify Bug Reports well.

articleTitle: Design of Miniaturized Quadrupole Waveguide Filter Based on Spatial Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this work, a miniaturized 2.11GHz quadrupole waveguide filter based on spatial multiplexing has been developed. The fourth-order bandpass filter consists of two compact waveguide structures, which multiplexes two concave waveguide elements in the z-axis direction and reduces the volume of traditional rectangular waveguide at the same frequency. The electromagnetic simulation analysis of the waveguide filter with this structure is presented in detail. The waveguide filter has a size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$60^{\ast}60^{\ast}37\ \text{mm}^{3}$</tex> and Q value reached 1967, which shows the excellent selectivity. For the compact bandpass filter, the insertion loss is lower than 0.15 dB and return loss is higher than 17.7dB.

articleTitle: Implementation of Multi-Channel TEC Temperature Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper develops a thermoelectric cooler (TEC) temperature control system based on the field-programmable gate array (FPGA). Multi-channel analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) acquire temperature data from the temperature sensors, with resolution of 0.002°C. The noises of the acquired data are processed and reduced using the principle of noise correlation, which is realized in an integrated Digital Signal Processing (DSP). Temperature control algorithm is implemented in the FPGA. Control signals are sent to multi-channel digital to analog converters (DACs) to control the current amplifiers, which drive multiple thermal actuators to heat or cool a temperature-sensitive plant. An ARM microcontroller is used to exchange data between DSP and FPGA. Such a system can be used for temperature control of a micro-positioner.

articleTitle: Data Center Monitoring Based on Equipment Clustering and Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The data center is the infrastructure of the modern information society, it is vitally important to continuous monitor the data center's equipment for the stable operation. Real-time performance and low resource consumption are required for monitoring by larger and larger data centers. To meet this demand, this paper proposes a data center monitoring method based on equipment clustering and data fusion. Optimize cluster monitoring of data center equipment based on network management costs and equipment running characteristics, then data collection and data fusion are performed by the selected cluster head. This saves time and network bandwidth resources for the entire monitoring solution. The simulation experiment results show the effectiveness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: A Cross-Domain Aggregation Routing based on Lightweight OSPF Protocol for the GEO Satellite-Ground Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Under the constraints of high cost of spacecraft devices and space environment, satellite communication devices are all characterized by small size, light weight, low power consumption and high performance. Due to the limited processing capacity on satellites, reducing routing overhead is an important optimization direction for designing onboard routing. In this paper, a cross-domain aggregated routing based on lightweight OSPF protocol (CDAR-L) is proposed for the GEO satellite-ground integrated network. Compared with OSPF, the routing overhead of CDAR-L is reduced by nearly 2/3, and has the same performance in terms of end-to-end delay, delay jitter and throughput. CDAR-L effectively alleviates the dilemma of limited satellite node resources, and makes an important reference for the routing design of the satellite-ground integration network based on the LEO network and the multi-layer satellite network.

articleTitle: Space-Time Correlations of EEG Time-Series
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The spatially distributed stochastic signals are evolving both in time and in space. Their observations represent multivariate time-series of samples acquired uniformly in time, but often non-uniformly in space. It is claimed that temporal and spatial domains of multi-dimensional signals are equivalent in computing the signal transformations and metrics. The aim of this paper is to define space-time correlations of multivariate time-series data generated at multiple spatially dispersed sensors. In order to reduce a possibly large dimensionality of the spatial index, it is proposed to assume a one-dimensional spatial shift along a defined low-dimensional spatial trajectory or manifold. Moreover, the sample alignment between the space-time shifted multi-dimensional signals can be defined as the nearest neighbor problem. A public EEG dataset is used as an example to calculate the intra- and inter-cluster space-time correlations and also distributions of signal correlations versus the sensor distances.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional DOA estimation algorithm based on empty holes data filling by using tensor modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Tensor modeling can effectively improve the two-dimensional DOA estimation performance of the coprime planar array. However, the virtual array it constructs is not completely continuous, which will cause some virtual array elements to be unused, and the loss of the virtual array aperture. In this paper, a two-dimensional DOA estimation algorithm based on empty holes data filling is proposed by using tensor modeling. The algorithm first constructs a virtual uniform planar array with a large aperture, and uses the covariance tensor of the received signal to fill in the data of the corresponding position, and the data is set to 0 for the unfilled position. Then the SVT algorithm is used to estimate the unfilled position data to obtain the covariance tensor of the virtual uniform planar array. Finally, the DOA of the signal is obtained by combining CP decomposition and spectral peak search. Simulation experiments show that the proposed algorithm effectively improves the estimation accuracy of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Based on The Improved BertForSequence-Classification Method Social Text Classification Topic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Text classification based on Bert Model has recently attracted much attention from researchers. Many adversarial training methods (e.g., PGM and PGD) also exist to increase the model robustness to improve the accuracy of the corresponding task. In this paper, We improve the traditional BertForSequence-Classification model and use freelb adversarial training to make it more robust. In contrast to the BertForSequence-Classification model, we add three linear layers and two softmax layers after the Bert Model. We chose among the datasets for two Twitter text classification tasks. The improvement of our improved model for this task is more obvious. In particular, we steadily improve the accuracy of the task again after using adversarial training. From the experimental results, we find that the more labels we classify, the greater the improvement in accuracy we have over the traditional model. This process do not only improve the task for our chosen dataset, but can also be extended to the whole task of text classification.

articleTitle: News Detection for Recurrent Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
