abstract: With the development of technology, the use of the Internet has basically spread to people in the whole society, and with the rapid growth of people's use of the Internet, the emergence of social media allows people to disseminate free information through social media and post it directly to the Internet without screening, thus leading to amplifying the impact of public opinion on fake news and creating more rumors that bring negative impact to the region or society. The purpose of this study is to test the accuracy of a method in deep learning: the recurrent neural network (RNN) model, for determining whether the news is true or false. We use the RNN to analyze and classify 44,901, true and false news publish from 2015 to 2017 with 10 epochs, and finally obtained 98.69% accuracy, which can prove that the RNN model is very efficient and accurate in analyzing and detecting true and false news in the data.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Technology Based on KG-Net
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In the field of computer imaging, the accurate segmentation of adhesion images is of great significance for follow-up research. Deep learning has also been widely used in image segmentation technology. However, in practical problems, the accuracy of the final image segmentation results is often affected by such issues as overlapping image positions and too small image area. Based on the kg-net convolution network model in deep learning, this paper takes cell image segmentation, which is widely used in imaging, as an example and proposes a method to effectively improve the accuracy of cell segmentation by using kg-net for different shapes of cells. The experimental results show that this method is suitable for image segmentation and worthy of further study.

articleTitle: Early failure monitoring of complex multi-variable dynamic processes based on empirical likelihood
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Dynamic processes are prevalent in actual industrial processes, and existing dynamic process research methods are lacking and ineffective in detecting faults. In this paper, an empirical likelihood-based early fault detection method for complex multivariable dynamic processes is designed. For the dynamic process with autocorrelation of process variables, a dynamic model is established and combined with the Kalman filter method, the estimated values and residuals of the dynamic process are monitored and analyzed respectively based on the empirical likelihood to achieve fast and accurate detection of early process faults. The application results of the dynamic process of blast furnace smelting show that the method has better detection effect and sensitivity than the traditional dynamic PCA, and meets the real-time demand of blast furnace production fault detection.

articleTitle: Robust Self-supervised Correspondence Learning for SAR-optical Image Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: SAR-optical image matching is a prerequisite for the joint use of these two modalities in many remote sensing applications. Due to significant nonlinear radiometric difference, it is a challenging task to perform robust matching between SAR and optical images. Recently, supervised deep learning methods have become the mainstream in the task of image feature matching, demonstrating the great power in feature description. One drawback of supervised deep learning methods is the huge demand for a vast amount of labelled training data, causing a big obstacle to its application in remote sensing. For this problem, we propose a self-supervised deep learning method to find correspondences using local image structure feature for SAR-optical image matching. In order to learn to exploit image structure cues, our network operates on the gradient of the input image instead of raw image intensity to produce dense descriptors, which paves the way for the self-supervised training. Next, a 4-D correlation map of SAR-optical images is computed using these descriptors. Lastly, reliable point-to-point correspondences can be extracted from the correlation map by means of the mutual nearest neighbor (MNN) and the RANSAC-based outlier removal. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method can establish robust correspondences between SAR and optical images with no demand for labelled data.

articleTitle: Predicting Effective Arguments with A Natural Language Processing Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Text is the main carrier of information on the Internet. More and more researchers are committed to mining textual information for great value. In terms of education, text mining can greatly help teachers and students to improve their writing. Computers can assist teachers in grading and classifying students' argumentative essays into three kinds: effective, adequate, ineffective. In this paper, we use data consisting of students' discourse and annotation provided by Kaggle platform. We utilize DeBERTa for Predicting Effective Arguments. We represent related work in section II, and introduce our methodology and experiment in section III and IV. To evaluate our experiment's performance, we do compared competitions. The predicting can be converted into a classification problem. We use the cross entropy as the metrics. Our Deberta-large owns the lowest metric 0.619 among these models, which is 0.007, 0.114, 0.030 lower than BERT, RoBERTa respectively, which shows our model has the best performance among them.

articleTitle: Preconditioned MAHSS Method for a Class of Complex Singular Saddle Point Problems And Its Semi-convergence Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a preconditioned MAHSS (PMAHSS) method for a class of complex singular saddle point problems, and analyze its semi-convergence. The eigenvalues of the iteration matrix of PMAHSS method is proven to be clustered for the appropriate parameters of the proposed new method. The theoretical results and the effectiveness of PMAHSS method is supported by numerical example.

articleTitle: Bursaphelenchus xylophilus disaster monitoring based on deep learning and Remotely sensed images
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the increasingly severe epidemic of forest diseases and insect disasters in China, the monitoring of forest diseases and insect pests has attracted more and more attention from the academic community. This paper first introduces the changes in the spectral characteristics and identification methods of Bursaphelenchus xylophilus disease. Secondly, the research status, research hotspots, and development trends of Bursaphelenchus xylophilus disease monitoring based on hyperspectral remote sensing are elaborated. It then discusses the development of deep learning and its research status in pest identification in combination with hyperspectral remote sensing and introduces three of the most popular methods of current Bursaphelenchus xylophilus disaster monitoring: You Only Look Once (YOLO), Faster Region-CNN (Faster R-CNN), and Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD). Finally, the main work and problems of the existing literature research are summarized to guide future work in this field.

articleTitle: Analysis and prediction of the impact of tunnel underpassing railroad based on ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Based on the background of Qingdao subway tunnel underpassing the railway, the calculation model was established by ABAQUS computer simulation software to study the influence of tunnel construction and train disturbance on railway subgrade. Through ABAQUS and its DLOAD subroutine and Visual Studio programming, different train running speeds were realized, and the variation law of subgrade acceleration was obtained. BP neural network model was used to predict the peak acceleration of subgrade. The results show that with the increase of the speed of the vehicle, the peak acceleration of the subgrade increases continuously, showing a double hump distribution; the vibration acceleration generated by train operation has obvious influence on railway subgrade. BP neural network can accurately predict the peak acceleration of subgrade under the combined action of tunnel construction and train operation.

articleTitle: Method to Supply Acoustic Positioning and Communication Service Simultaneously for Underwater Multiple Users
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: A method to supply acoustic positioning and communication service simultaneously for underwater multiple users is provided in this paper. It has three modes: integrated positioning and communication mode, independent positioning mode and independent communication mode. All three modes share the same hardware circuit and transducer to realize the interoperability of underwater acoustic positioning service and underwater acoustic communication service. The method could provide positioning and communication service at the same time for HOV, AUV, ROV and underwater glider to achieve cooperative networking tasks. This method is achieved based on spread spectrum communication technology. Pseudo random noise codes are mainly applied as the identification of different equipment and can be used as the ranging code to achieve high-precision ranging. Based on the same hardware circuits and time synchronization, the integrated underwater acoustic positioning and communication are realized to save energy and space. Meanwhile, it also serve independent underwater acoustic positioning and communication to ensure the positioning and communication performance.

articleTitle: A 3D Multi-domain U-Net Model for Intracranial Aneurysms Detecting
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Intracranial aneurysm is a higher fatality rate disease, but it is often difficult to make early diagnosis of unruptured intracranial aneurysms in clinical practice. Therefore, this paper presents a 3D multi-domain U-Net model for detecting unruptured intracranial aneurysms based on 3D TOF-MRA images, to assist physicians in detecting unruptured intracranial aneurysms fast and accurately. First, 3D TOF-MRA images are divided into three different domains according to intracranial aneurysms size in our model. Second, the correlation of the three domains is learned through depth separable convolution to realize the detection of intracranial aneurysms. Additionally, the deep supervision and residual connection are added to further improve the performance of our model. In the evaluation of 208 3D TOF-MRA images, the sensitivity and specificity of our model respectively reach 85% and 81%, and the number of parameters and training time are reduced by 23% and 22%. Therefore, the proposed model can effectively help doctors detect intracranial aneurysms more quickly and accurately which has high clinical application value.

articleTitle: Comparison of real-time precise point positioning between ionospheric-free model and uncombined model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper introduces the correction method of real-time precise satellite orbit and clock and the positioning principle of ionospheric-free model and uncombined model of precise point positioning. The positioning accuracy and convergence time of the two models in real-time GPS static precise point positioning are compared by using the GPS observation data of Brux station and DLF10 station and the satellite orbit and clock correction information of CNES station. The static positioning results show that compared with the ionospheric-free model, the uncombined model has slight difference in positioning accuracy, and the convergence time of the uncombined model is longer than that of the ionospheric-free model.

articleTitle: A Modulation Recognition Method Based on Bispectrum and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Modulation recognition of emitters is of great significance for reconnaissance signal analysis. In this paper, a method based on bispectrum features and ensemble learning algorithm is proposed for modulation recognition. First, according to the application of signal modulation patterns in radar and communication fields, a set of signal samples including four modulation patterns is simulated. Then, statistical features such as variance, kurtosis and kurtosis are extracted from the bispectrum diagonal slices of signals to construct a bispectrum feature set, which used as the input feature of the recognition model. Finally, an identifier based on extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) algorithm is constructed. Experimental results show that the bispectrum statistical features have satisfied feature expression and discrimination ability for signals with different modulation patterns, and the recognition model based on XGBoost algorithm has better recognition performance than the other seven recognition algorithms.

articleTitle: Modulation signal recognition based on lightweight complex residual attention neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: To address the problem of poor recognition performance of real-valued deep learning models in modulation recognition applications and the practical need for lightweight in real applications, this paper proposes a lightweight complex residual attention neural network model. By constructing a complex convolution module, the complex convolution operation of the convolution layer is implemented to extract features in the complex domain of the modulated signal, and a residual attention mechanism is introduced to further select key features for recognition and classification. The experimental results show that compared with the real-valued deep learning model, the proposed model extracts more spatial variability in signal classification features and is easier to recognize, and increases the recognition rate by 10% when the signal-to-noise ratio is greater than OdB. In addition, the resource consumption of the model is reduced. Compared with the basic model, the model parameters are reduced by 99%, and the floating-point operation is reduced by 56%.

articleTitle: A Direction Modulation Technique for Air-based Platform on Uniform Circular Array
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: For the security communication requirements in the physical layer of the air-based platform multi antenna system, a three-dimensional directional modulation technology based on a uniform circular array is proposed, which uses multiple objective functions to synthesize the phase shift value of the antenna array phase shifter, so that the constellation of the received signal in the desired direction is the same as that of the baseband digital modulation signal, but produces distortion in other directions. Compared with the traditional beamforming technology, the proposed directional modulation method has better physical layer security communication performance.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Early warning Strategy based on Rule engine
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the extensive application of underground cables in urban construction, cable damage accidents caused by external forces occur frequently. This paper introduces several common warning methods of cable breaking, and points out the advantages and limitations of each warning method. Based on the existing methods, this paper proposes a set of intelligent early warning strategy based on rule engine, aiming to achieve all-round real-time monitoring, control the damage behavior in advance, change the passive “supervision” to the active “monitoring”, improve the operation ability of power grid, and reduce the occurrence of cable breaking accident.

articleTitle: MTCA: A Multimodal Summarization Model Based on Two-Stream Cross Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The combination of vision and natural language patterns has become an important topic in the field of computer vision and natural language processing. With the rapid growth of multimodal information, multimodal summarization has received unprecedented attention. In this paper, we propose MTCA which composed of a pre-trained feature extractor, a text encoder, an image encoder, a two-stream cross attention fusion module and a summary decoder to complete the multimodal summarization task. This framework integrates three sub tasks: extractive summarization, abstractive summarization and image selection. At the same time, we introduce a residual network to alleviate the problem of modality-bias. Experiments show that the model is better than the baseline model and the performance is better than the text summarization method which ignores visual modality.

articleTitle: Resilient Control for Time-Delay Systems in Cyber-Physical Environment Using State Estimation and Switching Moving Defense
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Cybersecurity for complex systems operating in cyber-physical environment is becoming more and more critical because of the increasing cyber threats and systems' vulnerabilities. Security by design is quite an important method to ensure the systems' normal operations and services supply. For the aim of coping with cyber-attack affections properly, this paper studies the resilient security control issue for time-varying delay systems in cyber-physical environment with state estimation and moving defense approach. Time-varying delay factor induced by communication and network transmission, or data acquisition and processing, or certain cyber-attacks, is considered. To settle the cyber-attacks from the perspective of system control, a dynamic system model considering attacks is presented, and the corresponding switched control model with time-varying delay against attacks is formulated. Then the state estimator for system states is designed to overcome the problem that certain states cannot be measured directly. Estimated states serve as the input of the resilient security controller. Sufficient conditions of the stability of the observer and control system are derived out with the Lyapunov stability analysis method jointly. A moving defense strategy based on anomaly detection and random switching is presented, in which an optimization problem for calculating the proper switching probability of each candidate actuator-controller pair is given. Simulation experimental results are shown to illustrate the effectiveness of the presented scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Clustering Algorithm for Pedestrian Trajectory Flow Considering Multi-Camera Information
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the development of surveillance video systems from a single camera to a multi-camera network, the traditional video target trajectory clustering algorithm does not consider the camera position and field of view, resulting in poor clustering results. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a multi-level clustering algorithm for semi-supervised video target geographic flow. The proposed method is based on flow space and uses geographic flow hierarchical representation for video target trajectories to obtain geographic flow sub-segment sets at different levels. Meanwhile, this method takes the camera number as a label and performs semi-supervised clustering on the flow sub-segment sets at different levels. In this way, the clustering center set at the corresponding level is obtained, and the general trend of a large number of geographic flows is effectively described with cluster centers. The proposed method makes up for the shortcomings that traditional algorithms can only cluster at a single level and do not consider camera information, and its effectiveness is verified by a series of experiments.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition Using LDA And Stochastic Configuration Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition (HAR) research has made great strides, Compared with video-based human behavior recognition, sensors have the advantages of better privacy and convenience, making it an important emerging research area. When modeling the information collected by the sensor as the input of the neural network, if the input of the neural network contains too much redundant information, it will not only increase the modeling time, but also affect the classification accuracy of the model, and it is time-consuming to correctly determine the structure and hyperparameters of the neural network. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a method of using Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) to reduce the number of features of the original data, and then use stochastic Configuration Networks (SCN) to identify and classify human behavior. It was evaluated on the UCI-HAR datasets and achieved a classification accuracy of 98.61%, while reducing the modeling time to 4.03 seconds. Compared with the existing learning methods, the method we propose uses less dimensional feature data, the learning model structure is simpler, the recognition rate is higher, and the calculation process of the HAR system is simplified.

articleTitle: 3D-MTR: 3D Reconstruction Algorithms for Deep Understanding of Images
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Three-dimensional data can improve the performance of computer vision downstream tasks. In this paper, computer vision is introduced from the two-dimensional world to the three-dimensional world through the three-dimensional reconstruction algorithm. A 3D reconstruction algorithm, 3D Masked autoencoder Transformer Reconstruction (3D-MTR), is proposed for deep understanding of series view to restore 3D model. 3D-MTR can reconstruct 3D models with high-level semantic information in the series of views. Among them, in order to accurately extract and fuse the feature vectors with spatial information in the series of views, the MAE self-supervised learning pre-training is performed on the two-dimensional encoder; in order to make the reconstructed model more realistic, the Transformer-based two-dimensional encoder is compared with adversarial training. Combined, the model is updated through advanced semantic information; in order to make up for the uncontrollable defect of adversarial training, a repair network is added at the end of the model. In order to verify the validity of the model, a comparison experiment was conducted with three classic 3D reconstruction models on the ShapeNet dataset, using the Chamfer distance and the intersection-over-union ratio as the model evaluation indicators, and the experiments were conducted. Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis.

articleTitle: Virtual Gradiometer-Based Noise Reduction Method for Wearable Magnetoencephalography
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Optically Pumped Magnetometer (OPM) can be utilized to realize a flexible and wearable Magnetoencephalography (MEG) system that improves the tracking accuracy and detected signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). However, the OPM-MEG is highly sensitive to environmental magnetic-field interference and thus noise reduction is critical for high-quality signal detection. In this work, we demonstrated a virtual gradiometer-based noise reduction method for wearable OPM-MEG, where three reference OPM sensors are configured as the basis set to map the environmental interference. The reference sensors were placed on the support and the subject's scalp respectively and the head model, alpha-rhythm and auditory evoked response experiments were performed. The results show that the proposed method can remarkably reduce the common-mode magnetic-field noise in the whole detection frequency range. Even though the applied white magnetic-field noise reaches up to 1 pT/Hz1/2, the noise-floor of the denoised data can still be maintained near the limited sensitivity of the OPM sensors. Meanwhile, high SNR alpha-rhythm and auditory evoked response signals for the actual subjects can be measured under the noise correction by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Theoretical derivation of super-resolution sub-image stitching based on method of Lagrangian multipliers
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Researchers found that different regions in low-resolution (LR) images present different restoration difficulties. For large or small scales, a unified super-resolution (SR) network (large/small) will either waste computing resources and hardware resources, or it will be difficult to obtain the desired reconstruction effect. For this reason, researchers began to apply different processing strategies to different parts of images. Kong et al., for instance, first cropped LR images into sub-images and then processed these images that are hard to super solve using large-scale SR networks. Medium-scale networks were employed to process sub-images that were more difficult to super solve, a small-scale SR network was used to process sub-images that were easy to super-solve, and subsequently, these images were stitched together using weighted average fusion. The major focus of the above research method was to crop different regions into LR images, and then reconstruct and merge those images into a complete SR image using the weighted average fusion strategy. Although this strategy helped achieve satisfactory results, these results could often be adjusted through various experiments, and the setting of weights lacks theoretical guidance. In this paper, we propose a Lagrangian function for SR sub-image fusion and optimize the function through the method of Lagrangian multipliers. The research results provide a theoretical reference for the weights of SR sub-image stitching.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection algorithm of IoT devices based on semi-supervised heterogeneous ensemble learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: This paper proposes an abnormal behavior detection method based on semi-supervised heterogeneous ensemble learning to detect the abnormal behavior of IoT devices and solve the problems of data heterogeneity, weak generalization ability, and high label cost-efficiently and accurately. Firstly, the equipment is divided into three types: periodic type, trend type and random type according to the time series decomposition method and correlation coefficient. Secondly, two kinds of direct detection methods based on probability statistics and similarity measurement are adopted for the random equipment and indirect detection methods based on prediction or reconstruction before diagnosis are used for periodic and trend equipment. Finally, the optimal sub-model of each class is selected, and the heterogeneous integration model based on accuracy weighting is designed to make the anomaly detection more robust and accurate. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the LSTMs-AE + 3sigma sub-model is the highest, up to 81.09%, compared with many detection combination algorithms. The accuracy rate of the heterogeneous integration model obtained by selecting the optimal sub-models from different types of algorithms is as high as 89.25%, which is 8.16% higher than the individual sub-model. The false positive rate and false negative rate also decreased, only 5.05% and 2.08%.

articleTitle: Development and Enlightenment of Space Target Surveillance Resource Scheduling Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the rapid increase in the number of space targets, maintaining stable cataloguing is increasingly under increasing pressure on the space target surveillance network, and efficient resource scheduling can effectively improve the catalog management capabilities under the condition of limited observation resources. Firstly, the basic key issues of resource scheduling, such as different classification methods of space targets, corresponding observation needs, observation equipment and their use characteristics, are introduced. Secondly, the basic process of resource scheduling of the spatial target surveillance center is sorted out, and the strategies and methods that can optimize the comprehensive surveillance benefits of the target surveillance network and optimize the use of equipment are deeply analyzed. Finally, combined with the main problems facing the surveillance of space targets in our country,The enlightenment of different types of equipment resource scheduling is analyzed, which is of reference significance for optimizing the scheduling technology of space target resources in China.

articleTitle: Research on Web Components Association Relationship Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The security of web components is increasingly concerned by the industry, and identifying web components is of great significance to both network attack and defense. To solve this problem, first, a positive and negative association rule mining method based on the DW-SCCI framework is proposed. The DW-SCCI framework performs weighted frequent itemsets mining based on dynamic item weights, and then performs positive and negative association rule mining based on indicators such as interest. Second, an association rule quality evaluation method based on the weight of the common rule index is proposed, which is used to evaluate the quality of association rules mined by different algorithms. Third, on the basis of mining association rules, the application scenarios of association rules are analyzed and studied. The experimental results show that the positive and negative association rules mined by the DW-SCCI framework are of high quality, and have good results in Web component identification and abnormal website mining.

articleTitle: A plug-in that simulates gaze and glance functions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The convolutional neural network gradually extracts the local features of the image through several convolutional layers. Studies have shown that the spatial correspondence of these features is particularly important. In the biology field, studies have shown that compared with human visual saliency, the Saccade path of the human's eye can better reflect human visual search behavior, and deepen the impact on dynamic visual attention. Therefore, to further improve the representation ability of the network, this paper constructs a network structure of Glance From top to bottom network (Gftb-Net), which can simulate the gaze of the human eye and stimulate the glance function and stimulate the brain's long-term and short-term memory mechanism, the network can selectively retain the characteristics of important features to further build interdependencies, adaptively change the feature information at the row and column level of the picture, and further improve the ability to collect global information. Based on the correlation between image rows and columns, a channel interaction strategy based on LSTM for collecting images to give weights between rows and columns is proposed. This method effectively combines the relationship between image rows and columns with spatial attention to extracting effective weight information. Then, the matrix dot product is combined with the attention vector after global pooling and standard deviation pooling, which effectively improves the representation ability between image rows and columns. The network's top1_accuracy has been reached at 79.25% in the Imagenet-100 classification task. Experiments have proven that the network is effective, and the plug-in can theoretically be used after any convolutional layer.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Model of Host Micro- Segmentation in Distribution Master Station Based on Distributed Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The traditional host-agent-based micro-segmentation scheme can effectively prevent wanton damage after attackers invade the internal business network, but there are still the following two shortcomings. The first is that the solution cannot sense the location of the compromised node, which will lead to the destruction of other nodes that have legitimate communication links with it; secondly, if the software functions installed in the host are too complex for security reasons, it will occupy more host resources, which affects the execution of normal programs. Because of the above problems, this paper proposes an automatic generation technology of host micro-segmentation based on distributed intrusion detection. By installing an agent in each host to collect host operating information and implement a micro- segmentation strategy, the collected data will be sent to an independent server where a policy computing unit is deployed. The policy computing unit performs intrusion detection and analysis according to the information collected by each host, updates the segmentation policy according to the analysis result, and sends it to the agent software of each host. The proposed technology can greatly improve the security of the internal network without occupying too many service host resources.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation for Detection Techniques on Host Anomalous Behavior Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The detection of unknown attacks inside the host usually adopts the methods of constructing a normal behavior model, monitoring the internal state of the host and auditing the program activity log. With the increase of detection data, the detection efficiency and accuracy of traditional host abnormal behavior detection technologies will decline significantly. Machine learning based detection methods can effectively improve the detection efficiency and accuracy, and become an important direction of host abnormal behavior detection research. We introduce the basic situation and challenges of host based anomaly detection technology, summarizes the characteristics and application scenarios of three types of research dataset, including network, internal threat and malicious code, and focuses on analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of detection technology models based on traditional machine learning and deep learning in recent years To improve the robustness of the detection model and the evaluation index of the model performance, the feasibility suggestions for the next technological development are put forward.

articleTitle: Automatic Machine Learning-Based Data Analysis For Video Game Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: The paper analyzes the reviews and sales of video games from review websites Metacritic and VGChartz. It establishes classification and regression models through EasyDL, Vertex AI, and Azure, exploring the relationship between users and video games, media scores, and game sales. It is concluded that users' evaluations of video games are greatly influenced by media attitudes, while there may be a correlation between user evaluation and game sales. In addition, the paper also compares the results of training models on different automatic machine learning platforms. It shows that training on EasyDL is faster in general. In contrast, the training results of Vertex AI are greatly affected by data sets, and the effect of Azure is relatively balanced.

articleTitle: A Distributed Malicious Traffic Detection Method for Power Grid based on Private Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: With the continuous popularization of electric vehicles and distributed photovoltaics, the integration of distributed energy into the low-voltage distribution network has become an important solution to reduce the pressure of power generation and save power resources. However, the types of distributed power generation are numerous, the number is huge, and the geographical distribution is scattered, so that manual management, dispatch, and maintenance are very difficult, providing an opportunity for malicious attackers to crash the distribution network system. Based on the current situation of low-voltage distribution networks, we analyze and describe the current risk, that is, the outermost layer of the distribution network - the distribution terminal may have the risk of being maliciously attacked and cleaned up the traces of attack. To defend it, we propose a lightweight method for detecting the malicious traffic, in which decision tree model and private chain are involved. An experiment was conducted on the communication data of a grid and achieved 90.3% accuracy, which proves that the method is effective in improving the safety level and traceability of distribution network.

articleTitle: Investigation of The Transmission Loss in Sand and Dust Environment Based on Longley-Rice Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI)
abstract: Based on the Longley-Rice model, we established a radio transmission loss model suitable for the sand and dust environment, which takes into account the correction of the complex dielectric constant and the sand and dust characteristic attenuation. The effects of electromagnetic parameters related to sand and dust environment on transmission loss are investigated in detail. The results demonstrate that an increase in sand and dust particle size and an uneven distribution will increase radios' absorption and scattering in a sand and dust environment, which will increase radios' transmission loss. Additionally, sand and dust particle density, sand volumetric moisture content, frequency, and the dust environment scale will all have a big impact on radio transmission in sand and dust environment. Thus, the results of this study can serve as a guideline to improve the quality of terrestrial radio communication.
